Fix contradictory and inconsistent copy (too-short threshold, placeholders, hints, Arcade 'Today')

items.title: Trends: fix the bucket hydration bug, add sticky jump links and collapsible groups, rename the grouping control, keep the KPI row in place
items.spec:
File: apps/web/components/analyzer/TrendsTab.tsx (uses apps/web/lib/useLocalStorageState.ts unchanged). This is in wave 2 because item 1 is a real bug.
1. Hydration bug: the bucket preference is read with a lazy useState initializer that calls localStorage (~L53-56). lib/useLocalStorageState.ts:7-17 documents this exact pattern as a hydration-mismatch bug that once left chip groups unclickable. Switch to useLocalStorageState<'day'|'week'|'month'>(LS_BUCKET, 'week') with a validator that turns unknown values into 'week', and drop the manual writeLs effect. mechanics-progress (W3) shares this key ('analyzer.trends.bucket') for its bucket picker and must use the same hook.
2. Rename the 'Activity grouping' control (~L91) to 'Group charts by' (Day · Week · Month), with the helper text 'Applies to activity, matchup, MMR and map charts'. The control also drives MatchupOverTimeChart, MmrProgressionChart and MapTrendChart (~L142, 156, 182).
3. Sticky jump nav: add a bar that sticks below the AppChrome context bar. It holds the chips Overview · Performance & MMR · Time & activity · Explorer · Fingerprint, with the 'Group charts by' control on the right. Below sm the chips scroll horizontally and the control wraps underneath. Each group gets a section wrapper with an id (trends-overview, trends-performance, trends-time, trends-explorer, trends-fingerprint) and an h2, replacing the two inline SectionDividers. Clicking a chip calls scrollIntoView with behavior 'auto' under prefers-reduced-motion and 'smooth' otherwise, sets aria-current on the chip, and focuses the section heading (tabIndex=-1). faster-dashboards (W5) later adds scroll-spy and DeferredSection to this same nav; its spec should reuse this nav, not build a second one.
4. Collapsible groups: each section h2 contains a toggle button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Collapsed state is saved per group with useLocalStorageState('analyzer.trends.collapsed', {}). A collapsed group does not mount its charts, which saves requests. Jumping to a collapsed group expands it.
5. KPI row (~L105): while loading, render a skeleton row of the same height (role=status, sr text 'Loading summary'). On error, render the shared RequestError from data-states-recovery in that slot instead of nothing. The page then stops shifting.
Tests: a server render, then hydration with 'month' stored, logs no hydration warning and ends on 'month'; an invalid stored value becomes 'week'; the label reads 'Group charts by'; a chip click calls scrollIntoView with 'auto' when matchMedia(reduce) matches; collapsed state persists across remount and the group's charts unmount; the KPI skeleton shows while isLoading.
items.howto: Help article 'trends' (apps/web/lib/help/articles/analyzer.ts): add a short 'Getting around' paragraph. It says the section links jump to each chart group, groups can be collapsed and stay that way, and 'Group charts by' sets day, week or month buckets for every over-time chart.

audit.title: Trends: sticky jump navigation, an accurately named grouping control, a stable KPI row, and an SSR-safe preference

items.title: Builds, Strategies and Maps tables: keyboard-openable builds, matchup chips, a drill-down sheet, a matchup-scoped heatmap and CSV export
items.spec:
Depends on global-filter-clarity (W1) for the MatchupPicker setter and describeActiveFilters, and on data-states-recovery (W1) for NoFilterMatches. Conflicts in W3: strength-adjusted-winrates adds a 'vs expected' column and range bars to the Builds, Strategies and Maps tables, and map-veto-planner reworks BattlefieldTab. Merge this pack after both, or rebase onto them. analyzer-home-polish-5 binds the drill-down to the URL after this pack.

A. Builds table (builds-table-a11y-and-matchups). File: apps/web/components/analyzer/BuildsTab.tsx.
1. Desktop rows (md and up) open the editor only through `<tr onClick>` (~L175-180). Render the build name cell as a `<button type=button>` (left-aligned, hover underline, focus-visible ring) that calls the same open handler as the mobile card (~L118-121). The row's onClick stays as a mouse convenience with no role or tabIndex, and the button stops propagation so the editor does not open twice.
2. Rename the 'Trend' header (~L170) to 'W/L split'; the WrBar is unchanged.
3. Matchup chips from row.myMatchups (~L27): show 'vP 12 · vT 8 · vZ 20' under the build name, skipping zeros and sorting by count. Each chip is a button that sets the global opp_race through global-filter-clarity's MatchupPicker setter, so the app keeps a single matchup filter. Render nothing when myMatchups is missing.
4. Search (~L80-85): replace the one-off input with components/ui/Input, labelled 'Search builds' (visible or sr-only).

B. Strategies (strategies-drill-and-heatmap, plus the view-toggle a11y from builds-table-a11y-and-matchups). Files: apps/web/components/analyzer/StrategiesTab.tsx, StrategiesTabBuildVs.tsx, apps/web/components/ui/Stat.tsx, apps/web/components/ui/Tabs.tsx.
1. View toggles: 'Build vs strategy' / 'By opponent strategy' (StrategiesTab ~L691-704) and 'Table' / 'Heatmap' (StrategiesTabBuildVs ~L123-131) become a segmented control. Use components/ui/Tabs.tsx if it has a pill variant with role=tablist, aria-selected and arrow keys. Otherwise add components/ui/SegmentedControl.tsx with role=radiogroup, aria-checked and arrow keys.
2. Drill-down: StrategyGamesView (~L668-679) currently replaces the page, and its only way back is a small '← back to strategies' text button (~L360-366). Render it inside components/ui/Modal (size 'xl', mobileLayout 'sheet') titled '<strategy or build> · N games', with a close button and Escape; Modal returns focus to the clicked card or cell. The list or heatmap stays mounted behind it, so scroll position is kept. A filter change no longer closes the drill silently (~L672-675): the modal refetches, shows the active filters at the top (describeActiveFilters), and shows NoFilterMatches if the entity now has 0 games. Turn the drill state into a controlled prop pair (drill, onDrillChange) so polish-5 can bind it to ?drill=.
3. Heatmap (StrategiesTabBuildVs ~L164-169): add a matchup selector ('vP · vT · vZ · All') above it. It defaults to the most-played matchup in the response rows (ties go to All), and it is hidden and locked to the global value when global opp_race is set. Sort rows and columns by games played, descending, with an 'A–Z' toggle saved in useLocalStorageState('analyzer.bvs.sort'). Drop builds and strategies with 0 games in the selected matchup, which removes the sparse cross-race rows.
4. Cell legibility (~L236-237): stop applying opacity to the whole button. Encode sample size as background alpha instead (the wrRamp colour at alpha 0.35 to 1, scaled by n against Min games). Keep the label at full opacity, choosing #0c0c0c or white, whichever reaches 4.5:1 against the background composited over bg-surface. chart-kit (W5) later only swaps the ramp onto tokens.
5. KPI row: replace the local KpiStrip (StrategiesTab ~L109-138) with StatCard from components/ui/Stat.tsx, in the same grid Today uses.
6. Show the 'View games' hint on cards (~L274-276) at all times in text-text-dim, at full emphasis on hover and focus, so touch users can see it.

C. CSV export (table-csv-export). New apps/web/lib/csvExport.ts.
1. toCsv({columns:[{key,label,format?}], rows, scope}) returns a string. It quotes and escapes commas, quotes and newlines; prefixes a ' to any cell starting with = + - or @ (the same injection rule replay-library-control uses server-side); writes a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings; and leaves numbers raw (win rate as 0.583). Row 1 is 'Scope' plus '<describeActiveFilters summary> · exported <local date-time>', row 2 is blank, and row 3 is the header.
2. downloadCsv(filename, csv) builds a Blob, creates an object URL, clicks a temporary <a download>, then revokes the URL. Filenames follow sc2tools-<section>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv in the user's local date.
3. Add an 'Export CSV' ghost Button (Download icon, aria-label 'Export these rows as CSV') to the table headers of: BuildsTab; StrategiesTabBuildVs (long format build, strategy, matchup, games, wins, losses, winRate, in both table and heatmap views); and BattlefieldTab's matchup table and per-map table, plus the pool card rows once map-veto-planner lands. Each export contains exactly the visible rows after search, Min games, matchup and sort. With 0 rows the button is disabled and says 'Nothing to export'. Build each column list from the same config the table renders, so later columns such as 'vs expected' flow into the CSV.
4. opponents-list-mobile-rivals' Opponents export calls this helper; if it landed first with its own Blob code, move it onto the helper in this PR. The Replays export stays the server CSV from replay-library-control.

Tests: BuildsTab keyboard path (Tab to the build-name button, Enter opens the editor); the header reads 'W/L split'; clicking a matchup chip sets opp_race; Input has the accessible name 'Search builds'; segmented controls expose aria-selected or aria-checked and respond to arrow keys; the drill opens a Modal, Escape closes it and focus returns to the card, and the list stays in the DOM; a filter change keeps the modal open and refetches; the heatmap defaults to the most-played matchup and sorts by games, with A–Z available; heatmap cells have no opacity style and the contrast picker returns at least 4.5:1 at both ramp ends; toCsv unit tests for escaping, the injection prefix, the BOM and the scope row; the export button produces the right filename and visible-row count (mock URL.createObjectURL).
items.howto: Help articles 'builds', 'strategies' and 'maps' in apps/web/lib/help/articles/analyzer.ts. Builds: you can open a build with the keyboard, and matchup chips set the global matchup. Strategies: drill-downs open in a sheet (Escape or Back closes it), and the heatmap has a matchup selector and sorts by games or A–Z. All three articles get the line 'Export CSV saves exactly the rows on screen, with your filters written in the first line.'

audit.title: Builds table: keyboard-openable rows, an honest 'Trend' column, matchup split and a labelled search
Strategies: drill-down in a sheet, a matchup-scoped heatmap sorted by volume, and design-system stats
Add 'Export CSV' to the analyzer tables (Builds, Opponents, Maps, Build vs strategy, Replays page)

items.title: Keep your place: section view state in the URL, a compact Replays header and controls, and Daily Pulse with arrows and contextual links
items.spec:
Depends on shareable-views (W3), which owns global-filter URL sync and the 'Copy link to this view' button, and on analyzer-home-polish-4 for the controlled Strategies drill sheet. This pack also edits files that other W3 items rework: opponents-list-mobile-rivals (OpponentsTab), replay-library-control (the ReplayLibrary toolbar) and map-veto-planner (BattlefieldTab). Merge it after those in W3.

A. View state in the URL (url-addressable-views)
1. New apps/web/lib/useUrlState.ts: useUrlState<T>(key, {parse, serialize, defaultValue, mode:'replace'|'push'}), built on useSearchParams and router.replace/push(url, {scroll:false}). It omits a key whose value equals the default, offers setMany to batch several keys into one navigation, and debounces text inputs by 300 ms before writing. Read order is the URL, then the section's existing localStorage value, then the default. If shareable-views already added its own URL plumbing in AnalyzerProvider, extract it into this hook so there is one mechanism.
2. Section keys must not collide with AnalyzerFilters/filtersToQuery keys (since, until, race, opp_race, map, build, opp_strategy, regions, map_pool, game_size, preset, patch_era, and so on). Use: Strategies ?view=bvs|opp and ?drill=<build|strategy>:<name>; Replays ?q=&result=win|loss&matchup=&sort=date_asc&cursor=&before=; Opponents ?q=&impact=&sort=<col>:<dir>; Arcade ?tab=daily|quick-play|…; Builds ?q=; Maps ?focus=<map>. Never use ?map= for Maps, because that is the global map filter.
3. Strategies (StrategiesTab ~L668-679): bind polish-4's controlled drill prop to ?drill=. Opening the drill pushes a history entry, so browser Back closes the sheet. The close button calls router.back() when this session pushed the entry, and replace otherwise. ?view= uses replace.
4. Replays (ReplayLibrary ~L47-53): search, result, matchup, sort and cursor come from the URL, and changing any filter clears the cursor. cursorHistory, which 'Newer' needs, lives in sessionStorage keyed by the filter key; when it is missing after a reload, show 'Back to newest' instead of 'Newer'. Opening a replay and pressing Back restores the page and filters and scrolls to the row that was opened (its id is kept in sessionStorage).
5. Opponents (OpponentsTab ~L91-103): q (debounced), the MMR-impact filter and sort come from the URL. A sort in the URL overrides the persisted sort, and returning from a dossier keeps the query.
6. Arcade (ArcadeTab ~L21): the sub-tab lives in ?tab=.
7. shareable-views' 'Copy link to this view' copies window.location.href, which now carries section state as well.

B. Replays polish (replays-library-polish). Files: replays/ReplayLibrary.tsx, replays/ReplayList.tsx.
1. Remove the hero card (~L232-253). The archive card header shows 'Replays', a count Badge and a 'Share' button that opens the existing share modal. Show the hero's message ('Personal match tape: every replay, ready for review') once as a dismissible tip, remembered with useLocalStorageState('replays.introDismissed').
2. ReplayList's empty state (~L53-63) takes an action prop. ReplayLibrary passes 'Clear replay filters', which resets q, result, matchup and before but keeps global filters, plus 'Reset all filters' when global filters are non-default.
3. scrollToList (~L431-435) uses behavior 'auto' when prefers-reduced-motion matches.
4. Replace the result select (~L164-172) with segmented chips: All · Wins · Losses (aria-pressed, 44px on touch). Ties remain visible under All.
5. 'Jump to date': a date input sets ?before=YYYY-MM-DD. It is sent to /v1/replays as until=<end of that day>, using the earlier of it and the global until. It clears the cursor and shows a removable 'Before 12 Mar 2026' chip. No API change.

C. Daily Pulse (daily-pulse-discoverability). Files: DailyPulse.tsx, dashboard/TodayView.tsx, lib/dailyPulse.ts.
1. Gate copy (~L200-202, 299-330): "See today's insights from your replays: streaks, rising builds, nemesis sightings", with a 'Show insights' button. Show no count before loading, because the count is unknown then. analysis-corpus-local-cache (W5) later replaces this gate with a one-time load and should keep this 'what you get' sentence.
2. Carousel (~L211): on md and up, add prev/next icon buttons (aria-label 'Previous insight' / 'Next insight', disabled at the ends) that scroll by one card, honouring reduced motion. Add an 'n of N' indicator (aria-live=polite) driven by IntersectionObserver. ArrowLeft/Right work when the scroller has focus. Phones keep swipe with scroll-snap.
3. Clickable cards (~L432) get focus-visible:ring-2 ring-accent ring-offset-2.
4. Deep links keep their context. Cards in lib/dailyPulse.ts gain an optional targetQuery: {q} for builds, {focus} for maps, and pulseId for opponents. DailyPulse (~L382-385) and TodayView (~L229) navigate to hrefForTab(tab) plus that query: a rising build goes to /app/builds?q=<build>, a map card to /app/maps?focus=<map>, and a nemesis card to /app/opponents/<pulseId> when known. For ?focus=, BattlefieldTab scrolls to that row, highlights it, and opens its games modal once map-veto-planner's click-through exists. Cards without context still go to the section root.

Tests: useUrlState round-trips values and omits defaults; typing produces replace (no history spam) and opening a drill produces exactly one push; Back from a replay restores the page, filters and scroll target; Back closes the Strategies drill; the Opponents query survives a dossier round trip; the Arcade tab comes from the URL; a static test checks that no section key equals a filtersToQuery key; the Replays empty-state action clears local filters; reduced motion gives 'auto'; result chips expose aria-pressed; before= becomes until on the request; carousel buttons are disabled at the ends and the indicator updates; Daily Pulse hrefs include q or focus.
items.howto: Help articles in apps/web/lib/help/articles/analyzer.ts. 'analyzer-filters' #save-and-share-a-view (from shareable-views): drill-downs, replay page and search, opponent search and the Arcade tab are now part of the link, so Back returns to the previous drill level and a copied link opens the same view. 'replays': result chips, Jump to date, and clearing replay filters. 'today': the Daily Pulse arrows, and that cards open their section already narrowed to that build, map or opponent.

audit.title: Put analyzer view state in the URL so Back, refresh and shared links keep your place
Replays: a compact header instead of the hero, empty-state reset, reduced-motion scroll and quick result chips
Daily Pulse: a clearer opt-in, carousel controls, focus rings and context-preserving deep links

items.title: Game page cards: honest loading/error states, crash isolation, accessible controls and a correct Ghost grade
items.spec:
One PR covering the cards around the replay. Depends on data-states-recovery (W1: QueryState, RequestError, SectionBoundary) and lands after it in the same wave. If SectionBoundary has not merged yet, add optional onReset/resetKeys and a 'Try again' button to components/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx without breaking it.

Roadmap interplay: game-page-macro-workspace (W3) later swaps InteractiveTimeline for MacroChartSection on the owner page and turns the 404 empty states into a Recompute button. It must keep the loading/error/notComputed contract defined here. game-story-fight-ledger (W3) replaces the Result card. build-order-supply-export (W3) moves the Ghost arm button into a ⋯ menu and must reuse useArmGhostTarget from here. ghost-synced-practice (W4) must accept GhostTarget.sourceGameId in services/ghostConfig.js and its parity fixture.

These components are also used by PublicReplayAnalysis, ReviewReplayPanel and instant/report GameDetail/LastLossCard. Every new prop is optional, and omitting it keeps today's behaviour.

1) Honest states (apps/web/components/analyzer/game/GameDetailPage.tsx)
- Derive macroStatus from macroReq: 'loading' | 'notComputed' (error.status 404 or code macro_not_computed) | 'error' (any other error) | 'ready'. Derive buildStatus from buildReq the same way.
- InteractiveTimeline.tsx: new props loading?, error?, onRetry?.
  - loading: a chart-shaped skeleton (h-64 block with faint axis lines, role=status, 'Loading timeline') instead of 'No timeline samples…' (InteractiveTimeline.tsx:104-114).
  - error: an inline RequestError row "Couldn't load the timeline · Retry" with Retry calling macroReq.mutate().
  - notComputed: keep the current copy.
- MechanicsPanel.tsx: add error/onRetry. Show 'No macro breakdown for this game…' (MechanicsPanel.tsx:138-151) only for notComputed; any other error shows the Retry row.
- LossAutopsyCard.tsx:
  - add loading (3 skeleton rows) and error/onRetry;
  - show 'Not enough data to explain this one' (LossAutopsyCard.tsx:46-51) only once the breakdown request has settled with 404, or the rules genuinely found nothing;
  - while loading, never show the empty copy.
- BuildOrderColumns.tsx: add error/onRetry. Show 'No build events were parsed from this replay' (BuildOrderColumns.tsx:139-141) only after a successful empty response.
- Page-level 'Couldn't load this game' (GameDetailPage.tsx:151-158): add a Retry button (gameReq.mutate(), aria-busy while revalidating) next to Back. Copy by error code via RequestError: timeout or 503 says 'The server is waking up, which can take about 30 seconds'; offline says 'You're offline'.
- New components/analyzer/game/GameDetailSkeleton.tsx: back-link bar, hero block (h-40 rounded-xl), timeline card (h-64), replay-shaped block (h-[52vh] max-h-[36rem], xl:h-[min(88vh,1040px)]) and a two-column row. Used by app/app/game/[gameId]/loading.tsx and by the GameDetailPage loading branch (GameDetailPage.tsx:161-170), so the layout doesn't jump. aria-busy plus an sr-only 'Loading game'.

2) Crash isolation
- In GameDetailPage, wrap each section in SectionBoundary with a friendly label and a 'Try again' that remounts via a reset key:
  - InteractiveTimeline: 'The timeline hit a problem'
  - MapReplaySection: 'The replay player hit a problem'
  - the Mechanics/Autopsy grid: 'Mechanics hit a problem'
  - GhostGradeCard
  - BuildOrderColumns: 'Build orders hit a problem'
- GameDetailShell, the hero, stays outside every boundary.
- Add apps/web/app/app/game/[gameId]/error.tsx (client; {error, reset}): a branded Card 'This game page hit a problem', with 'Try again' (reset()), 'Back to dashboard' (/app) and captureException on mount.

3) Accessibility
- BuildOrderColumns heading (BuildOrderColumns.tsx:128-131): render the toggle <button aria-expanded> with md:hidden and a plain <h4> with hidden md:flex. At md and wider, nothing focusable claims the always-visible body is collapsed. Mobile behaviour is unchanged.
- ProductionRail Queue/On Field tablist (ProductionRail.tsx:212-233): add roving tabindex (selected tab 0, others -1), ArrowLeft/ArrowRight wrap, Home/End, and selection follows focus. Alternatively use components/ui/Tabs if it supports controlled compact mode.
- Hit areas: raise the supply-block chips (MechanicsPanel.tsx:202), autopsy timestamp chips (LossAutopsyCard.tsx:105) and the GhostGradeCard 'Per-step breakdown' toggle (GhostGradeCard.tsx:176) to a 44px hit area. Keep the compact look with a transparent ::before inset (-6px vertical) or min-h-[44px] with negative margin, and keep at least 4px gap between wrapped chips so hit areas don't overlap.
- Severity (LossAutopsyCard.tsx:66-71): replace the bare number with a title tooltip by a visible pill 'High · 73'. Thresholds match the bar colours: ≥67 High (danger), 34–66 Medium (warning), <34 Low (success). aria-label 'Severity 73 out of 100, high'.

4) Ghost Build self-grade (apps/web/lib/ghostBuild.ts, GhostGradeCard.tsx)
- GhostTarget gets optional sourceGameId (string of at most 64 chars). normalizeGhostBuildConfig drops invalid values so stored older configs still parse. fromBuildLog(name, lines, {sourceGameId}).
- GhostGradeCard takes a gameId prop (GameDetailPage passes game.gameId). When target.sourceGameId === gameId, render no grade and show: 'This game is your armed PvZ target. Your next PvZ games will be graded against it.' plus the existing Disarm action.
- Extract a useArmGhostTarget() hook for ArmGhostFromLogButton:
  - Label: 'Use as Ghost Build target' (short label 'Ghost target' below sm).
  - title/tooltip: 'Your next PvZ games are graded against this build, and the Ghost Build overlay shows its steps while you play.'
  - If a different target is already armed for the matchup, open ConfirmDialog: "Replace “<old name>” with this game's build?"
  - If this game is already the armed target, show the label 'Armed for PvZ' with Disarm.
  - The success toast carries an Undo action that restores the snapshot read before writing.
  - Keep the 'Settings → Overlay' URL hint until ghost-synced-practice replaces it.
  - Random or unknown matchups keep the current disabled states.

items.title: Opponents list stays on screen: no skeleton on new replays, rows stream in, readable errors with retry, smooth search
items.spec:
Goal: a streamer's Opponents table never blanks when a replay lands, the first rows appear after one round trip, failures are readable and retryable, and search stays responsive with thousands of opponents.

1) apps/web/lib/useApiPaginated.ts
- Split requestKey into an identity key [userId, path, pageLimit, maxPages] and the dbRev revision.
- Revalidation (same identity, only dbRev changed): do NOT call setState(emptyState(requestKey, true)) (:83). Keep items and set a new isRefreshing:true while isLoading stays false. Collect all pages into a local buffer and swap them in with one setState at the end, so the table never shrinks to page 1 mid-refresh. Relax the mismatch guard (:148-150) so items for the same identity keep returning while refreshing.
- Account safety: any userId change (sign-out, account switch) still returns emptyState immediately. Never render another account's rows.
- Cold load (no items yet for this identity, including a filter/path change): publish after each page. isLoading is true only until the first page arrives. A new isLoadingMore stays true while later pages load. pagesFetched and hitMaxPages are set on the final page. A path change still clears (rows from another filter would mislead), but page 1 now shows quickly.
- If dbRev changes again mid-refresh, abort the in-flight loop (existing AbortController) and restart. Never run two loops at once.
- Errors: never throw the raw body (:100-102). Parse JSON {error:{code,message}} into a ClientApiError-shaped object {status, code, message} (type from lib/clientApi.ts) with friendly copy. 401: 'Your session expired. Sign in again.' 503 or *_busy: 'The server is busy. Try again in a moment.' A fetch TypeError (code network_unavailable): 'Can't reach SC2 Tools. Check your connection.' Other errors: 'We couldn't load your opponents.' Keep the original code for RequestError.
- A failed revalidation keeps the previous items and sets error plus isStale:true.
- Expose retry(), which bumps an internal attempt counter in the effect deps.
- Return type gains isRefreshing, isLoadingMore, isStale and retry. Update the mock in components/analyzer/__tests__/OpponentsTab.mmrImpact.test.tsx.

2) apps/web/components/analyzer/OpponentsTab.tsx: states
- showSkeleton stays isLoading && rawItems.length === 0 (:261).
- The count line (aria-live=polite) shows 'Updating…' with a small spinner while isRefreshing, and 'Loading more opponents… (1,000 so far)' while isLoadingMore.
- While isLoadingMore, the MMR impact leader cards show a muted '(still loading)' caption, because leaders can change as pages arrive.
- Replace the raw 'Could not load opponents — {json}' (:338-342) with a role=alert banner and a 'Try again' button that calls retry() (aria-busy, 'Retrying…'). Use components/ui/RequestError.tsx if data-states-recovery has landed; otherwise mirror OpponentReplayHistory.tsx:99-118. This pack takes over data-states-recovery's 'OpponentsTab L340' migration line.
- Stale refresh with rows still visible: a slim inline warning 'Couldn't refresh after your last game. Showing the list from before.' with Try again, instead of replacing the table.

3) Performance (list-performance)
- Use const deferredSearch = useDeferredValue(search) for the filter at :228-232. The input stays immediate, and the tbody is dimmed (opacity-70, aria-busy) while search !== deferredSearch.
- Memo the sorted array on [filtered, sort.col, sort.dir] (:244-247).
- Windowed render: show the first 200 sorted rows (groups count as one in grouped mode), plus a 'Show 200 more (of 3,412)' button under the table that keeps focus. Reset the window to 200 when search, sort, min games, MMR impact or grouping change. Do NOT reset it when a dbRev refresh swaps items or more pages stream in. Counts and the status line always use the full filtered total.
- Extract the row JSX (:460-537) into React.memo OpponentRow({row, expanded, onToggle, onOpen}) with useCallback handlers, so expanding one alias group re-renders one row.

Edge cases: a user with 0 opponents (no skeleton loop, the empty state shows); a fetch abort on unmount is not shown as an error; 8-page cap behaviour unchanged.

Tests (vitest + RTL, fetch mocked):
- hook: a dbRev change keeps items and sets isRefreshing; a userId change clears; a cold load publishes after page 1 and sets isLoadingMore; a JSON error body gives friendly copy and keeps the code; retry() refetches; a failed refresh keeps items with isStale; a double dbRev bump aborts the first loop.
- OpponentsTab: no skeleton while refreshing with rows; the error banner's Try again calls retry; 450 rows render 200 plus 'Show 200 more'; the window resets on search change and is kept on refresh.

Dependencies:
- Same wave as data-states-recovery. Land after it, or ship the local banner and let it swap in RequestError.
- realtime-one-connection (wave 2) later debounces dbRev bumps. This pack is still required because each bump would otherwise blank the table.
- opponents-list-mobile-rivals (wave 3) must render its mobile cards from the same windowed, memoised list.

items.spec:
1) API, apps/api/src/services/opponents.js
- The unfiltered list already returns the full doc, including notes (:380-382). The filtered path (_listFiltered, :531-541) never overlays notes.
- Add one batched find over the opponents collection {userId, pulseId: {$in: pageIds}}, projection {pulseId:1, notes:1}, the same way _overlayFromOpponents fills identity fields.
- On BOTH paths emit notesMeta: { preview } (whitespace collapsed, at most 140 chars), absent when there are no notes. The unfiltered path keeps notes for backward compatibility.
- Name and shape notesMeta so notes-and-review-queue (wave 6, 'GET /v1/opponents attaches notesMeta') extends it with count and tags rather than redefining it.
- Test: a filtered list returns notesMeta only for opponents with notes, using exactly one extra query per page.

2) List, apps/web/components/analyzer/OpponentsTab.tsx
- Rows with notes show a lucide StickyNote icon after the name. It is a focusable button with aria-label 'Scouting note: {preview}'. The preview shows on hover and focus via title until glossary-and-infotip's InfoTip lands in wave 5. Read notesMeta.preview, falling back to notes.
- A grouped row has notes if any member does; it shows the first preview plus '+N more'.
- Add a 'Has notes' toggle to the toolbar. It filters client-side, is part of opponents-polish-2's Reset defaults, and syncs to the URL as notes=1.
- Empty: 'No opponents with notes yet. Add one from any dossier.'

3) Editor, apps/web/components/analyzer/OpponentNotesCard.tsx
- Draft safety:
  - Persist a dirty draft to sessionStorage 'opponent-note-draft:{pulseId}', debounced 500 ms.
  - On mount, if a stored draft differs from the saved notes, restore it into the editor with the notice 'Unsaved draft restored · Discard'.
  - Clear the draft on save or discard.
  - Register beforeunload while dirty (pattern from components/ui/SaveBar.tsx:41-42).
  - Expose isDirty through a small useUnsavedNote context, so the dossier's '← All opponents' and breadcrumb (opponents-polish-2) open ConfirmDialog 'Discard unsaved note?' (Keep editing / Discard) before navigating.
- Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) saves when the textarea is focused and the note is dirty (:334-352, :383-391). Hint text under the box: 'Ctrl+Enter to save' or '⌘+Enter to save'.

items.title: Library page: instant search, filters that survive Back, one honest counter, plain-language re-matching and text fixes
items.spec:
Coordination: this lands in the same wave as visitor-dead-ends (signed-out branch in BuildsLibrary), builds-correctness-fixes (first-run copy in BuildsLibrary) and data-states-recovery (global SWR keepPreviousData, BuildsPanel 'Loading…' text). Merge after visitor-dead-ends and rebase. data-states-recovery and ui-primitives-and-dialogs should drop BuildsPanel.tsx from their lists, because this pack deletes it.

1) Search that keeps results (BuildsLibrary.tsx, useCustomBuildPage.ts)
- Extract the local debounce in components/analyzer/charts/NetMmrRaceOpponentsModal.tsx into lib/useDebouncedValue.ts and reuse it there.
- BuildsLibrary keeps `searchInput` (bound to the input, immediate) and the committed `filters.search` (debounced 250 ms). Enter and clearing commit immediately.
- useCustomBuildPage: change keepPreviousData:false to true (useCustomBuildPage.ts:47) so a new key keeps the previous page on screen. `isInitialLoad` is then true only before the first response.
- While revalidating with previous data, the grid gets aria-busy="true" and opacity-60 (transition-opacity, no animation under reduced motion). A small 'Updating…' status (role=status) appears beside the counter. The skeleton (BuildsLibrary.tsx:427-431) is never shown again after first load.

2) Filters in the URL
- On mount, read ?q=, ?mu= (validated against COMMON_MATCHUPS), ?sort= (updated|winRate|games|name) and ?hide=1. Ignore invalid values.
- When committed filters change, write them with router.replace(`/builds?…`, {scroll:false}). Omit defaults so a plain /builds stays clean. Never write on raw keystrokes.
- Wrap BuildsLibrary in <Suspense> in app/builds/page.tsx for useSearchParams.
- Do not put page cursors in the URL: they are filter-scoped and expire. Store the cursor stack in sessionStorage under `builds:cursors:<queryKey>` (try/catch) so Back from /builds/<slug> restores the page. If the API answers 400 invalid_custom_build_page, clear the stack and load page 1 silently.

3) Search input (BuildFilterBar.tsx)
- Add an X clear button when non-empty (aria-label 'Clear search', 44px hit area), same pattern as DefinitionsCatalog.tsx:94-103.
- '/' focuses the search when focus isn't in an input, textarea, select or contenteditable and no dialog is open. Implement it as lib/usePageSearchShortcut.ts, which registers the page's search element. find-anything (wave 5) binds '/' globally to its palette and must defer to a registered page search.

4) One honest counter
- Remove 'Showing {shown} of {total} builds' (BuildFilterBar.tsx:122-125). That number is the page's item count, so page 2 reads '50 of 120'. Drop the `shown` prop.
- New summary: with no filters, '120 builds'. With filters, '12 of 120 builds match' (page.total vs page.libraryTotal), or '12 builds match' when libraryTotal is null.
- Active-filter count = search + matchup≠All + hideEmpty (sort excluded). When it is above 0, show a ghost button 'Clear filters (n)' that resets to DEFAULT_FILTERS (keeping sort) and cleans the URL.
- The no-match EmptyState (BuildsLibrary.tsx:436-442) lists the active filters ("Search ‘blink’ · PvT · Hide empty") and gets the same 'Clear filters' button. Its old text instructions go away.
- BuildPagination: 'Page 2 of 3 · builds 51–100 of 120' (pages = ceil(total/limit) when total is known, else 'Page 2'). On page change, scroll the grid heading into view ('auto' behaviour under reduced motion) and focus it (tabIndex=-1).

5) Plain-language re-matching
- Rename 'Reclassify replays' to 'Re-match replays' everywhere a user sees it: the header button (BuildsLibrary.tsx:364-375), the BuildCard kebab ('Re-match replays' / 'Re-matching…', BuildCard.tsx:601), the editor save bar ('Save & Reclassify' → 'Save & re-match', BuildEditorSaveBar.tsx:102) and the error toasts ('Couldn't re-match replays').
- Add a visible helper line under the PageHeader description, replacing the title tooltip: 'Re-match checks every saved replay against your build rules again. It runs in the cloud, so you can leave this page.'
- API (apps/api/src/services/customBuilds.js reclassify job): at job start, set optional `progress.total` = count of the user's games the scan will visit (same filter as the scan).
- ReclassifyStatusPanel: with total>0, show a determinate bar (role=progressbar, aria-valuenow/max) and '{scanned} of {total} replays checked'. Otherwise show '{scanned} replays checked so far'. Deferred games read '· {n} waiting for replay data'. The engineering wording 'tag changes found · stale removals planned' goes away.
- Completion summary: '{tagged} games matched · {cleared} old matches removed'. Keep the deferred sentence, worded 're-sync the desktop app to repair them'.
- Failure: describeReclassifyFailure maps status.error codes (reclassify_queue_failed, reclassify_unavailable, timeouts) to friendly copy and keeps the generic fallback. Add a 'Try again' button that calls reclassifyAll. Show 'Error ID' when the status carries a request id.
- Delete the dead describeReclassify (BuildsLibrary.tsx:523-542).

6) Text fixes and dead code
- Replace the mojibake 'settingâ€¦' with 'setting…' in BuildEditorSheet.tsx:558 and BuildPublishModal.tsx:230.
- Add apps/web/lib/__tests__/noMojibake.test.ts. It scans app/, components/ and lib/ .ts/.tsx for 'â€', 'Ã¢' and U+FFFD, and fails listing file:line.
- Delete components/BuildsPanel.tsx, which is imported nowhere and carries stale custom_builds.json copy.
- In BuildGamesTable, delete the unused filterGameIds/filterLabel/onClearFilter props, FilterChip and the filter path (BuildGamesTable.tsx:48-58, 133-140, 235-265) and their tests. BuildDossier's CompositionSampleGames remains the filtered view.

Tests
- BuildsLibrary.test: three keystrokes within 250 ms send one request; the grid stays mounted (no Skeleton) and shows 'Updating…' while revalidating; router.replace receives q=blink; mounting with ?mu=PvT&sort=name&hide=1 sets the controls; bad params are ignored; Clear filters resets state and URL; '/' focuses search but not while typing in another input; Back restores the cursor page.
- BuildFilterBar counter strings, including libraryTotal null. BuildPagination 'Page 2 of 3'.
- Status panel: determinate vs indeterminate, failure Try again calls reclassify-all, completion copy.
- API: progress.total is set at job start.
- The noMojibake guard.
items.howto: Add a 'Re-match replays' section to the custom-builds help article (apps/web/lib/help/articles/builds.ts → /help/custom-builds and /settings?tab=help#custom-builds). Cover what re-matching does, that 'Save & re-match' runs it for one build, and why some replays wait until the desktop app re-syncs. If help-center-foundation has not merged yet, add the paragraph to the builds section of components/analyzer/settings/SettingsHelp.tsx.

items.title: Build editor: never lose edits, private notes in the editor, one Edit everywhere, and a visible build definition
items.spec:
Scope: roadmap unified-build-editor (wave 4) owns the create-side unification: the 'New build' Start-from chooser, retiring BuildEditorSheet and the TokenPicker. This pack lands first and only touches parts that item keeps: BuildEditorModal close handling, the SaveBar, Basics and the launcher. unified-build-editor should treat 'BuildDetailView always uses the launcher' as done. This pack depends on builds-correctness-fixes (wave 1) for the RulesSummary component.

1) Unsaved-changes guard
- BuildEditorModal reads `isDirty` (useBuildEditorState.ts:461, returned at 657 but unused today) and routes every close path through requestClose(): Modal onClose (Esc, scrim), the header X and SaveBar Cancel.
- When dirty, open ConfirmDialog: title 'Discard changes to “<name or this build>”?', body 'Your rules and preview changes haven't been saved.', buttons 'Keep editing' (initial focus) and 'Discard' (danger). Esc in the confirm closes only the confirm.
- A successful save marks the state clean before onClose, so no prompt appears. Landing demo mode skips the guard.
- Add a beforeunload listener only while open && isDirty.
- BuildEditorSheet (still used by 'New build' until wave 4): snapshot the initial form state, compare with JSON equality, and use the same ConfirmDialog and beforeunload.

2) Save errors
- BuildEditorSaveBar's error (`flex-1 truncate`, line 70) becomes a wrapping inline callout above the buttons: role=alert, danger tokens, break-words, max-h with scroll after about 4 lines.

3) One toast system
- Replace the editor's own BuildEditorToasts strip with useToastOptional() from components/ui/Toast.tsx (success→success, warn→warning, error→error). Render an action {label, href} as a link inside the toast description.
- Fall back to the local strip only when no provider exists. Delete BuildEditorToasts.tsx if nothing else uses it.
- Global toasts sit at z-60, above Modal's z-50.

4) Personal notes in the rich editor
- BuildEditorDraft gains `notes: string` (default '').
- EditCustomBuildLauncher.toInitialDraft seeds it from doc.notes. This is required: once notes is in the PUT body, an unseeded draft would blank existing notes.
- BuildEditorBasics: under Description, add a textarea labelled 'Personal notes (private)' with helper 'Only you see these: scouting tells, timings to remember, reminders.' maxLength 8000 (the API limit in validation/customBuild.js), with a counter after 7000.
- The useBuildEditorState save body adds `notes` (trimmed, capped).
- BuildEditorModal gets an optional `initialFocus: 'notes' | 'preview'`. The dossier NotesPanel's 'Edit the build to capture scouting tells' link (BuildDossierModal.tsx:173-180) opens the editor focused on notes.

5) One Edit everywhere
- BuildDetailView always renders EditCustomBuildLauncher. Remove the BuildEditorSheet branch (BuildDetailView.tsx:170-185) so it matches the library.
- For signature-only builds (no rules, signature present), BuildEditorModal shows an info callout above Rules: 'This build uses the older signature format. Click a timeline row to turn it into a rule. Until you add one, it keeps matching by its signature.'
- Saving without rules keeps the signature: the API's boundedBuildClone leaves absent fields untouched. Add an API test that pins this.

6) Build definition card
- New components/builds/BuildDefinitionCard.tsx, rendered in the dossier headerSlot on BuildDetailView and BuildDossierModal beside NotesPanel. Two columns on lg, stacked on mobile.
- It shows the rules via builds-correctness-fixes' RulesSummary, then chip rows 'Wins by' (winConditions), 'Loses to' (losesTo) and 'Transitions into' (transitionsInto), plus a 'Skill level' badge. These fields are authored today but displayed nowhere.
- Empty rows are hidden. The card is hidden when there are no rules, no signature and no strategy notes. A pencil button opens the editor.

Tests
- BuildEditorModal: dirty + Esc opens confirm; Keep editing keeps it open; Discard calls onClose; clean Esc closes at once; no prompt after save; beforeunload is registered only when dirty.
- BuildEditorSheet dirty prompt.
- SaveBar: a long error renders without truncate.
- useBuildEditorState: notes in the PUT body, and edit mode preserves the initial notes.
- BuildDetailView: Edit on a signature-only build mounts the launcher, not the sheet.
- BuildDefinitionCard: chips render and empty rows hide.
- API: a PUT without signature or notes keeps both.
items.howto: In the custom-builds help article (apps/web/lib/help/articles/builds.ts, /settings?tab=help#custom-builds), add 'Private notes vs public description' (notes are never published), 'Strategy notes and skill level' (where they show), and a line that closing the editor with unsaved changes asks first.

audit.title: Guard against losing unsaved edits in both build editors
One editor for create and edit, with Personal notes in it

items.title: Build dossier: one guided zero state, a real recent-form card, section nav, and a games table that works from the keyboard
items.spec:
Dependencies: builds-correctness-fixes (wave 1) replaces WinRateTrend with a real rolling win-rate line, and builds-polish-1 (wave 1) removed BuildGamesTable's dead filter path. This pack builds on both. build-dossier-insights (wave 4) will add KeyTimingsCard and Plan survival; those must register in the section nav added here and stay hidden in the zero state.

1) Zero state (BuildDossier.tsx:190-225 renders every panel today)
- When data.totals.total === 0 and resumedCount === 0, render headerSlot (notes and definition card) plus ONE EmptyState card instead of about 12 cards of zeros.
- Copy: title 'No games matched this build yet'. Body: 'Builds count games once your replays are matched against the rules. If you just saved it, matching may still be running.'
- Action 'Re-match replays': POST /v1/custom-builds/:slug/reclassify, the call BuildsLibrary already makes. Show 'Re-matching… this can take a minute' and revalidate the dossier when reclassify-status completes. If a job is already running, show 'Matching is running…' instead of the button.
- Action 'Edit rules': a new optional `onEditRules` prop opens the editor with initialFocus='preview' (prop added in builds-polish-2; if that pack hasn't merged, simply open the editor).
- Action 'Review check-ins': only when GET /v1/build-intents/pending returns items. It mounts BuildCheckInQueue, which is self-contained.
- BuildDossier gains `slug` and `onEditRules` props, wired from BuildDetailView and BuildDossierModal.
- With 1–4 games, render the panels but add one warning-tone line under Performance: 'Only N games so far: treat percentages as early signals.'

2) Recent form (replaces the mislabelled 'Win-rate trend (per-game record)' card, BuildDossier.tsx:456-458)
- Rename the card to 'Recent form'. Keep builds-correctness-fixes' rolling 10-game line.
- Add a W/L dot strip of up to the last 20 games from `recent`, oldest to newest: success for win, danger for loss, neutral for tie. Each dot has a title 'date · map · result', and an sr-only ordered list carries the same information.
- Below 10 games, show the dots plus 'Not enough games for a trend yet'.
- Remove any remaining code that charts data.byMatchup as a 'trend' (722-747). TopMatchups already shows per-matchup W-L.

3) Section nav (full page only)
- BuildDetailView gets a sticky in-page nav under PageHeader: Overview (#overview) · Army (#army) · Matchups & maps (#matchups) · Games (#games).
- BuildDossier wraps its blocks in sections with those ids and scroll-mt-24.
- An IntersectionObserver sets aria-current on the active link. On mobile the nav is a horizontally scrolling pill row.
- Hidden in the zero state. Not rendered in the modal.

4) Games table (BuildGamesTable.tsx)
- Desktop: the first cell holds a real disclosure `<button aria-expanded aria-controls="build-game-<id>-detail">` with a chevron and the date. The detail row gets that id. A row click stays as a mouse shortcut but ignores clicks that come from links or buttons. Today the `<tr onClick>` at 278-286 is mouse-only.
- Add an 'Open' column: an icon link to /app/game/<gameId> (aria-label 'Open game vs <opponent> on <map>', 44px target). The mobile card gets a text link 'Open game'.
- Results: add resultLabel(result) → 'Win'|'Loss'|'Tie'|'Unknown' in components/analyzer/game/types.ts next to isWinResult/isLossResult, with badge variants success/danger/neutral. Today every non-win shows 'Loss' (424-429). builds-polish-6 reuses this helper.
- Sorting: useSort + SortableTh (components/ui/SortableTh.tsx) on Date (default desc), Map, Length, Macro and Result. Sort within groups; resumed games stay grouped.
- Quick filter chips above the table: All · Wins · Losses · vs P · vs T · vs Z (aria-pressed, with counts; race chips only for races present). An empty result shows 'No games match this filter' with Clear.
- Title: when totals.total > recent.length, 'Latest {recent.length} of {totals.total} games' with helper 'Older games still count in every stat above.' (the API caps the list at 50). Otherwise 'Recent games · N'.
- Build-order load error in an expanded row (494-496): show 'Couldn't load this game's build order.' with a 'Try again' button that refetches and an Error ID from ClientApiError.requestId. No raw red error.message.
- Fix the doc comment that promises a 'sortable-style table'.

Tests
- Keyboard: Tab reaches the disclosure; Enter expands; aria-expanded and aria-controls are correct. The Open link href is right.
- Tie, draw and unknown results map to 'Tie'/'Unknown'. Length sorts asc/desc. Filter chips narrow rows. The capped title appears when total > recent. Retry refetches the build order.
- BuildDossier: total 0 renders one card with its actions and no PerformanceTiles; the 1–4 game caution shows; the section ids exist; the dot strip renders min(20, n) dots.
items.howto: Add a 'Reading a build's page' section to the custom-builds help article (apps/web/lib/help/articles/builds.ts, /settings?tab=help#custom-builds). Explain what each dossier block means, why a new build shows no games until replays are re-matched, the low-sample caution, and that the games list shows the latest 50 while every stat uses all games.

items.title: Build cards and actions: last played, low-sample cue, Duplicate, View/Copy/Unpublish, and one set of publish labels
items.spec:
Coordination: build-library-safety (wave 6) lists Duplicate in the kebab. It should treat Duplicate and the delete-confirm listing warning as delivered here, and add Practice/randomizer/share code/Pin to this same menu. ghost-synced-practice (wave 4) adds Practice here too. community-forks-and-trust (wave 6) later adds a toggle to BuildPublishModal. ui-primitives-and-dialogs (wave 5) brings CopyButton/useCopy. Until then, copy with navigator.clipboard and fall back to a selected read-only input, then swap later. This pack touches BuildFilterBar and useCustomBuildPage after builds-polish-1 (wave 1); rebase on it.

1) Kebab menu (BuildCard.tsx:584-625)
- New order: Open full page · Edit · Duplicate · Re-match replays · — · Publish… / Update listing · [public only] View on Community · Copy public link · Unpublish · — · Delete.
- Open full page: a Link to /builds/<slug>.
- Duplicate: EditCustomBuildLauncher gains `intent: 'edit' | 'duplicate'`. Duplicate fetches the doc as today, sets the draft name to '<name> (copy)' (truncate the base to fit the name cap; use '(copy 2)' when the current page already has '(copy)'), shareWithCommunity false, and keeps notes, rules, strategy notes and sourceReplayId. It opens BuildEditorModal with mode='create', createOnly and no lockedSlug. A server 409 slug conflict shows the existing 'already exists' error so the user can rename. On success, toast 'Duplicated as “X”.' and revalidate the page.
- View on Community / Copy public link: publicSlug comes from GET /v1/community/my-build-publication/:slug (the launcher already uses it), fetched lazily when the menu opens on a public build. Items are disabled with 'Loading…' until it arrives. Copy writes `${location.origin}/community/builds/<publicSlug>` and toasts 'Link copied'.
- Unpublish: ConfirmDialog 'Unpublish “<name>”?' with body 'It disappears from Community builds. Your private copy, stats and notes stay.' and button 'Unpublish'. Call DELETE /v1/community/builds/<publicSlug> (the existing owner route), then the owner publication read (mirror repair, as the editor does), then revalidate the library and build. Toast 'Unpublished.'; errors toast the message plus the request id.
- The dossier modal header and the BuildDetailView header get the same actions. The detail page puts Duplicate, View on Community, Copy link and Unpublish in a 'More' menu next to Edit, Publish and Delete.

2) One set of labels and honest copy
- Use 'Publish…' when private and 'Update listing' when public everywhere. Today the same action reads 'Publish update' (BuildCard.tsx:611), 'Update' (BuildDossierModal.tsx:117) and 'Update community' (BuildDetailView.tsx:147). When public, the BuildPublishModal title is 'Update your Community listing'.
- Replace 'You may unpublish at any time from the build's edit panel' (BuildPublishModal.tsx:322-327) with 'You can unpublish any time from the build's ⋯ menu.' Add a secondary 'Unpublish' button inside the publish modal when the build is already public.
- Publish success state (206-220): add a 'Copy link' button next to 'View on the community page'.
- Delete ConfirmDialog in BuildsLibrary and BuildDetailView: when isPublic, add 'Its Community listing will also be removed.'

3) Card stats (BuildCard.tsx:180-240)
- Replace the 'Total games: N' badge, which repeats the W·L record, with 'Played 3d ago' from stats.lastPlayed (fmtAgo, absolute date in a title). Fall back to 'Edited 3d ago'. Show only one of the two lines.
- Low sample: when 0 < total < 5, show a warning-tone 'Low sample' badge beside the win rate (title 'Fewer than 5 games: this win rate can swing a lot') and render the percentage in text-dim instead of wrColor, per the design-system warning semantics.
- Loading: while statsState==='loading', show fixed-width skeleton bars (win rate w-12 h-5, record w-16 h-5) and an sr-only role=status 'Loading stats' in place of the '—' and 'Loading…' text, so the card height stays stable. If data-states-recovery already swapped in its Skeleton, reuse it.
- Sort 'Last played': add {value:'lastPlayed', label:'Last played'} to SORT_OPTIONS in BuildFilterBar, extend BuildSortKey and CustomBuildQuery.sort, and accept it in builds-polish-1's ?sort= validator.
- API (apps/api/src/services/customBuildPages.js): parseBuildPageOptions accepts 'lastPlayed'. buildStatsStages also computes `_stats.lastPlayed` ($max of the game date in the lookup). The stats stages run when sort==='lastPlayed', and the order is the lastPlayed epoch ms (never played = 0), descending, with the numeric cursor unchanged.

Tests
- BuildCard kebab items for public vs private builds.
- Duplicate opens BuildEditorModal in create mode with createOnly and the '(copy)' name.
- Unpublish: confirm → DELETE with publicSlug → revalidate. Copy link writes the clipboard.
- Label strings on the card, modal and detail page. New publish-modal copy and the Copy link button. Delete confirm mentions the listing only when public.
- Played vs Edited line, Low sample at 1–4 only, and the skeleton while loading.
- API: lastPlayed sort order and cursor round-trip; an invalid sort still returns 400.
items.howto: Custom-builds and publish-community-builds help articles (apps/web/lib/help/articles/builds.ts): add 'Make a variant with Duplicate', 'Publish, update and unpublish a Community listing' (the ⋯ menu path, and that deleting removes the listing), and a line explaining the Low sample badge.

items.title: Definitions: grouped by race and matchup, URL filters, deep links, and every strategy label links to its definition
items.spec:

This is the audit's Settings > Help 'Dashboard & analyzer' pointer.

items.title: Build check-in queue: Confirm all suggested, Undo, a real opponent picker, linked build names and a 44px header chip
items.spec:
Depends on builds-polish-3 (resultLabel in components/analyzer/game/types.ts) and on builds-polish-5 / builds-correctness-fixes (definitionHref and definition anchors). No roadmap item reworks these check-in files.

1) Confirm all suggested (BuildCheckInQueue.tsx QueueFooter, 230-311)
- Add 'Confirm all suggested (N)' next to 'Dismiss all' when 2 or more pending items carry a suggestion. It uses the same inline confirm: 'Confirm N suggested builds?' Confirm / Cancel.
- Run sequentially, in list order, through useCheckInActions.confirm(gameId, suggestion.key). Each item shows its own spinner, then its done line.
- On 401 or 429, stop and show 'Paused: <reason>. Retry remaining (n)'.
- An aria-live summary reads 'Confirmed 6 of 7. 1 failed. Retry'. Items without a suggestion are untouched.
- Closing the queue mid-run lets the in-flight request finish, then stops.

2) CTA labels (507-515)
- With no suggestion, the primary button reads 'Pick build…' (opens the picker) instead of 'Change…'. With a suggestion: primary 'Confirm <name>', secondary 'Change…'.

3) Results
- QueueResultBadge (541-548) uses resultLabel() → Win/Loss/Tie/Unknown instead of printing the raw API string.

4) Opponent build picker
- Extract OpponentBuildPicker from OpponentBuildRow.tsx and use it in queue items, closing the gap noted at BuildCheckInQueue.tsx:123-125. Keep 'Add new build…'.

5) Undo
- After Confirm or No set build, the done line (455-463) shows an 'Undo' button (44px) until the queue closes.
- API: add the action 'reopen' to GAME_ACTIONS in apps/api/src/validation/buildIntent.js and handle it in services/buildIntentGameState.js. It is allowed only when the status is confirmed or skipped. It clears the override (clearOverridePipeline with status 'pending', build null, confirmedAt null), keeps notes, and sends the same games-changed/intent ping as the other actions. Otherwise it returns 409 not_reopenable. The existing 'defer' cannot be used: it never undoes a decision.
- The item returns to pending with its suggestion. Undo of an opponent-build change re-sends the opponent action with the previous opponentBuildKey, which the client holds.

6) Linked names
- Add buildOptionHref(key) in lib/buildIntent.ts: 'custom:<slug>' → /builds/<slug>; catalog ids → definitionHref(label), or null.
- Planned and suggested names in queue items, BuildCheckInCard and DetectedLine render as links. The queue closes on navigation.

7) Header chip (BuildCheckInAlert.tsx, compact h-8)
- Keep the 32px visual but give it a 44px hit area (a before:-inset pseudo-element or a min-h-11 min-w-11 wrapper) without shifting the header layout.

Tests
- Confirm all calls confirm in order, renders per-item results, stops on 401, and retries the remainder.
- 'Pick build…' appears without a suggestion. Result badges map correctly. The picker renders in queue items. Undo calls reopen and the item returns to pending.
- API: reopen from confirmed or skipped → pending, with the override cleared and the game's label back to detection; reopen on none or pending → 409; validation accepts 'reopen'.
- The chip hit area is at least 44px.

items.title: Votes you can trust, honest reports, and a safe author page
items.spec:
Goal: close the stored-XSS hole on author profiles and make every vote-related number truthful.

1) Author JSON-LD XSS (security, ship first). In apps/web/components/community/AuthorProfile.tsx (around lines 46-51), replace JSON.stringify(personJsonLd) with serializeJsonLd(personJsonLd) from apps/web/lib/reviewJsonLd.ts. Add a test to apps/web/components/community/__tests__/AuthorProfile.test.tsx, copied from the hostile-title test in app/community/builds/[slug]/page.test.tsx (lines 65-74). Use displayName = '</script><script>alert(1)</script>' and assert that the ld+json script body contains no '</script' and no raw '<'. Add a guard test, apps/web/lib/__tests__/jsonLdSafety.test.ts. It globs apps/web/app/**/*.tsx and apps/web/components/**/*.tsx, finds every 'application/ld+json' script, and fails if the matching __html uses JSON.stringify instead of serializeJsonLd.

2) Votes API (apps/api/src/services/community.js, vote() at about line 1352; apps/api/src/routes/community.js at about line 298).
- vote(userId, slug, delta) accepts delta 1, -1 or 0, where 0 clears your vote. Any other value is a 400 with 'delta must be -1, 0 or 1'.
- Make the write atomic with one aggregation-pipeline update on {slug, removed:false}:
  - upvotes = $setUnion or $setDifference with [userId], depending on delta
  - downvotes the same, mirrored
  - votes = $subtract of $size(upvotes) and $size(downvotes)
  This removes today's read-then-write race on the cached count.
- If no build matched, return 404 build_not_found.
- Return {votes, myVote, changed}. changed is true only when the stored vote differed. notification-center (wave 2) should fire its community.vote producer only when changed && myVote === 1.
- The route responds 200 with {votes, myVote} instead of 204.
- New method myVote(userId, slug) and route GET /community/builds/:slug/my-vote (deps.auth). It returns {votes, myVote: 1|-1|0}, sends Cache-Control 'private, no-store', and returns 404 for missing or removed builds.

3) Vote panel (apps/web/components/community/CommunityVotePanel.tsx plus a new apps/web/components/community/useCommunityVote.ts).
- useCommunityVote(slug, initialVotes) seeds from useApi(`/v1/community/builds/${slug}/my-vote`) when signed in. The live count also corrects a stale SSR count once caching lands.
- It exposes {votes, myVote, cast(next), pending, error}. cast() sends delta 0 when next === myVote, which undoes the vote. The optimistic score is votes - myVote + next, then replaced by the server's {votes, myVote}; on error it rolls back. community-polish-4 reuses this hook for the mobile action row.
- Upvote and Downvote become toggle buttons with aria-pressed. The active one is filled (success tone for up, danger tone for down).
- Under the buttons, show 'You upvoted · Undo' or 'You downvoted · Undo'. Undo is a text button.
- Status messages are split by tone:
  - Errors: AlertTriangle icon, text-danger, role=alert. 429 → 'You're voting too fast. Try again in a minute.' 401 → 'Your session expired. Sign in again.' 404 → 'This build was removed.'
  - Success: role=status, no CheckCircle on errors.
- The signed-out link 'Sign in to vote or report' uses a new apps/web/lib/authLinks.ts with signInHref(returnTo) = `/sign-in?redirect_url=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`, the same mechanism /reviews uses today. auth-return-to-context (wave 5) later hardens this helper with safeReturnPath and does not replace call sites. community-polish-2 and community-polish-5 reuse it.

4) Report form, in the same panel.
- A fieldset with legend 'Why are you reporting this build?' and radio options. Each option sends its label as `reason`, so the admin queue stays readable without admin changes:
  - 'Spam or advertising'
  - 'Offensive or abusive'
  - 'Broken or wrong steps'
  - 'Copied without credit'
- An optional 'Add details (optional)' textarea, maxLength 280, with a live '0/280' counter, sent as `note`. The API already accepts note up to 1000 characters.
- Submit stays disabled until a category is picked.
- The response's alreadyReported flag decides the copy: true → 'You've already reported this build — thanks.' false → 'Thanks — a moderator will review this build.'

5) Controversial sort (_listControversial at about line 1201).
- In $addFields: up = $size(ifNull upvotes []), down likewise, total = up + down, minV = $min, maxV = $max.
- controversy = cond(total >= 4 && minV > 0, $pow(total, minV / maxV), 0).
- Sort {controversy:-1, minV:-1, total:-1, publishedAt:-1}. Builds below the threshold still list after the controversial ones. A +40/−0 build no longer tops the list.
- Keep PUBLIC_AGGREGATE_PROJECTION last, so up, down and controversy are never returned.
- In apps/web/components/community/types.ts, set the hint to 'Close split of up and down votes (4+ votes)'. Show the selected sort's hint as a caption under the sort Select in CommunityFilterBar.tsx, linked with aria-describedby, because the option title tooltip is hover-only.

Dependencies: builds-correctness-fixes (wave 1) edits builds/[slug]/page.tsx and SaveToLibraryButton. This pack avoids page.tsx; the panel seeds itself client-side. notification-center (wave 2) builds on the {changed} return value.

Edge cases:
- Double-click while pending is ignored.
- Signed-out users never call /my-vote.
- A build removed between page load and click returns 404 and shows the removed copy.
- Votes on your own build are allowed, as today.

Tests:
- API (apps/api/__tests__/communityAndGdpr.test.js or a new communityVotes.test.js):
  - three upvotes give +1
  - switching up to down moves the score by −2
  - delta 0 clears the vote
  - delta 2 returns 400
  - a removed slug returns 404
  - my-vote returns 1, -1 or 0
  - the route body is {votes, myVote}
  - controversial ordering fixture [+5/−5, +3/−2, +1/−1, +40/−0] comes back in that order
- Web (new apps/web/components/community/__tests__/CommunityVotePanel.test.tsx):
  - aria-pressed reflects myVote
  - clicking the active button sends delta 0
  - the displayed count is the server value
  - an error renders role=alert with the danger tone
  - alreadyReported copy
  - submit disabled until a category is chosen
  - note capped at 280 characters
- AuthorProfile and jsonLdSafety tests as described in step 1.

- #voting: one vote per account, click again to undo, switching moves the score by 2.
- #sorting: Top = net score, New = publish date, Controversial = a close up/down split with 4+ votes.
- #reporting: the four categories and the optional note, the moderator queue, one open report per build.

items.title: A Stock Market leaderboard that works for everyone, with real section navigation
items.spec:
Goal: today /community/leaderboard is empty for visitors and shows 0% rows for members. Make it useful, and make the Builds/Leaderboard switch real navigation.

1) Signed-out state (apps/web/components/community/LeaderboardTab.tsx).
- Until Clerk isLoaded, render the table skeleton, so the signed-out panel never flashes.
- Wrap the board in <SignedIn>. In <SignedOut>, render an EmptyStatePanel with:
  - icon LogIn
  - title 'Sign in to see this week's leaderboard'
  - body 'The board shows player names, so it's only visible to signed-in players. Portfolios always stay private.'
  - primary action 'Sign in' → signInHref('/community/leaderboard' plus the current ?week), using lib/authLinks.ts from community-polish-1
  - secondary action 'Sign up free'
- Keep requireAuth on GET /v1/arcade/leaderboard. It is a deliberate privacy rule (apps/api/src/routes/arcade.js:53).

2) Week picker. Replace the text input with '‹ Prev week' and 'Next week ›' buttons around a human label.
- New apps/web/lib/isoWeek.ts with:
  - weekKeyToRange(key) → Monday–Sunday
  - shiftWeekKey(key, ±1), correct across week 52/53 and year boundaries
  - formatWeekRange(key): 'Oct 13 – 19, 2026', 'Sep 29 – Oct 5, 2026', 'Dec 29, 2025 – Jan 4, 2026'
  Reuse weekKey() from components/analyzer/arcade/ArcadeEngine.ts for 'current week'.
- Next is disabled at the current week. A 'This week' shortcut appears whenever the viewed week isn't current.
- The selected week lives in the URL as ?week=2026-W42, via router.replace. That needs useSearchParams, so wrap LeaderboardTab in Suspense in app/community/leaderboard/page.tsx.
- An invalid or future ?week falls back to the default week.
- Add a visually-hidden <caption>: 'Stock Market weekly P&L, Oct 13 – 19, 2026'.

3) Settled-week default and your rank.
- API, apps/api/src/services/arcade.js:
  - submitLeaderboard accepts an optional boolean `settled` and stores it.
  - stockMarket.tsx (components/analyzer/arcade/modes/games/stockMarket.tsx) sends settled:true from the settle POST (about line 225) and settled:false from the lock-in POST (about line 328).
  - listLeaderboard(weekKey, {limit, userId}) becomes an aggregate over the existing {weekKey, pnlPct, updatedAt} index:
    - $addFields settled = (settled === true) OR (pnlPct != 0), because legacy non-zero rows count as settled
    - $sort {settled:-1, pnlPct:-1, updatedAt:1}
    - $limit (default 50, max 200)
  - Rows get rank (settled rows only; unsettled rows get rank null), settled and isYou (r.userId === userId). Strip userId before returning, and never return it.
  - The response adds participants (countDocuments {weekKey}) and settledCount.
  - It also adds you: {rank, pnlPct, settled} or null. rank = 1 + count of settled rows with a higher pnlPct, or an equal pnlPct and an earlier updatedAt, so it works outside the top N.
- Route, apps/api/src/routes/arcade.js: pass requireAuth(req).userId into listLeaderboard.
- UI:
  - With no ?week, default to the previous ISO week, because results settle only after a week ends.
  - On the current week, show a Badge 'In progress — results post after the week ends'. Every row shows 'Locked' in place of the 0.00% placeholder.
  - On past weeks, unsettled rows show 'Awaiting result' in dim text, with no rank, after the settled rows.
  - Highlight the isYou row (bg-accent/10 plus a 'You' badge).
  - Above the table, pin a strip: 'Your rank: #14 of 63 · +4.2%'. If you are unsettled it reads 'You're on this week's board — locked'. If you=null it reads 'You're not on this board. Opt in when you lock a portfolio.' with a link to /app/arcade.
  - Top 3 settled rows get medal styling: a Medal icon tinted warning, text-text-muted and an orange tint, with aria-label '1st place' etc.
  - 'Show more' raises limit 50 → 200. It only shows when participants > items.length.

4) States.
- Loading: a Skeleton shaped like the table (rank, name, P&L columns).
- Error: an EmptyStatePanel with CloudOff, 'Couldn't load the leaderboard' and a Retry button calling mutate(). Use QueryState/RequestError from data-states-recovery if it has landed in wave 1.
- Empty: 'No one has posted for this week yet', with a primary 'Open the Stock Market' button → /app/arcade.
- Drop the legacy Card EmptyState and Skeleton imports.

5) Section navigation (apps/web/components/community/CommunityShell.tsx).
- Replace the Tabs composite with <nav aria-label="Community sections"> holding two next/link items, 'Builds' → /community and 'Stock Market leaderboard' → /community/leaderboard.
- The active link gets aria-current="page" and the same underline styling as Tabs.Trigger.
- Remove useRouter and the 'use client' directive. An optional buildCount prop renders 'Builds · 57'.
- In app/community/page.tsx, retitle the index PageHeader to 'Community builds' (the eyebrow stays 'Community'). Leaderboard title: 'Stock Market leaderboard'. Update both metadata titles, using app-shell-quick-fixes' '%s · SC2 Tools' template if it has landed.
- Update apps/web/components/community/__tests__/CommunityShell.test.tsx to query role=link and aria-current instead of tabs.

Dependencies: visitor-dead-ends (wave 1) also edits app/community/page.tsx. Rebase on it; the conflict is only the header title. data-states-recovery provides QueryState if it is available.

Edge cases:
- A week with 0 participants.
- A user with two devices posting the same week; the upsert keys on userId+weekKey, so this is fine.
- Anonymous rows keep their 'Anonymous N' handles.
- Timezone: weekKey is computed in the viewer's timezone, as the Stock Market does.

Tests:
- apps/api/__tests__/services/arcade.test.js:
  - settled rows sort before unsettled
  - legacy non-zero rows count as settled
  - isYou is set and userId is never in the output
  - the you rank is correct when you are outside the limit
  - participants is counted
  - limit is capped at 200
- New apps/web/components/community/__tests__/LeaderboardTab.test.tsx:
  - signed-out shows the sign-in panel with redirect_url
  - Prev/Next change ?week, and Next is disabled on the current week
  - the current week shows 'Locked'
  - the you strip renders
  - Retry calls mutate
- apps/web/lib/__tests__/isoWeek.test.ts: range labels across month and year boundaries, and week 53.

- opting in when you lock a portfolio

- browsing past weeks and sharing ?week= links
- that the 'Your rank' strip is visible only to you

The LeaderboardTab header gets a 'How the leaderboard works' HelpLink. This depends on help-center-foundation (wave 1).

items.title: Browse builds: search that stays in sync, race / vs / skill filters, honest pagination
items.spec:
Goal: the /community grid filters reliably, gives feedback while it loads, and lets players find builds by their race, the opponent's race and their league.

1) Search stays in sync (apps/web/components/community/CommunityFilterBar.tsx).
- Keep a lastPushedRef holding the q value this component last wrote. Add useEffect on initialSearch: when it differs from lastPushedRef, setSearch(initialSearch). This covers 'Reset filters', 'Clear all' and browser back/forward.
- Do NOT key the bar by q. A remount after each debounced push would steal focus while you type.
- Keep `isPending` from useTransition.
- New CommunityFilterProvider (client context, components/community/CommunityFilterContext.tsx) wraps both the bar and a new <CommunityResults> client wrapper around the server-rendered grid in app/community/page.tsx. While pending, the results get aria-busy=true and opacity-60 with a transition. The search field's right slot shows a Loader2 spinner (no spin under prefers-reduced-motion) in place of the X button.
- In apps/web/app/globals.css, inside the @layer base introduced by css-cascade-fix (wave 1), add :where(input[type=search])::-webkit-search-cancel-button { -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none } so only the custom X shows.
- Do NOT bind '/'. find-anything (wave 5) reserves '/' for the global quick-search palette.

2) Race, vs and skill filters, which replace the 9 matchup chips.
- Two segmented controls, 'My race' (Any · P · T · Z with race icons) and 'vs' (Any · P · T · Z), each fitting on one row at 375px. Add a 'Skill level' Select: Any level, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Grandmaster.
- Sort gains 'Recently updated' (value 'updated') in COMMUNITY_SORTS in components/community/types.ts.
- Reuse the segmented control from global-filter-clarity's MatchupPicker if wave 1 shipped one. Otherwise add apps/web/components/ui/SegmentedControl.tsx: role=radiogroup, roving tabindex with arrow keys, 44px targets, aria-checked. MatchupPicker should then adopt it.
- URL params: race=P|T|Z, vs=P|T|Z, skill=<level>, sort=top|new|controversial|updated, q, offset. The legacy ?matchup=PvZ still works: page.tsx parses it into race=P and vs=Z, so old shared links and the sitemap keep working.
- Below the bar, show the result count with active-filter chips, for example: 'Showing 1–24 of 57 · [Zerg ×] [vs Terran ×] [Diamond ×] ['roach' ×] Clear all'. Clear all keeps the sort.
- Every filter change deletes offset (mergeQuery already does this).
- API, apps/api/src/services/community.js listPublic and the route in apps/api/src/routes/community.js:
  - Accept race, vsRace and skill. Validate against allowlists (P/T/Z or the full names; the 7 skill levels). Invalid values are ignored, not rejected.
  - Build the clauses into an $and so they combine with the search $or:
    - race → {'build.race': 'Zerg'}
    - vsRace → {'build.vsRace': {$in: ['Terran', 'Any']}}. Builds written for any opponent appear under every vs filter.
    - skill → {'build.skillLevel': 'diamond'}. Builds with a null level are excluded only when skill is set.
  - Keep the matchup param.
  - sort 'updated' → {updatedAt:-1, publishedAt:-1}.
  - Indexes in apps/api/src/db/connect.js: {removed:1, 'build.race':1, 'build.vsRace':1, votes:-1}, {removed:1, 'build.skillLevel':1, votes:-1} and {removed:1, updatedAt:-1}.

3) Pagination (Pagination in app/community/page.tsx).
- Build urlFor() from all current params, so race, vs, skill, sort and q survive paging.
- Disabled ends render as <span aria-disabled="true">, not focusable links.
- Show 'Page 2 of 5' between the buttons: floor(offset/limit)+1 of ceil(total/limit).
- If offset >= total and total > 0, show an EmptyStatePanel 'No more results' with 'This page is past the end of the list.' and a 'Back to page 1' action. This replaces the misleading 'No builds yet — be the first'.
- Empty-state copy now names the active filters: 'No Zerg builds vs Terran at Diamond yet'.
- Add LinkButton to apps/web/components/ui/Button.tsx: Button variants and sizes rendered through next/link, with the API ui-primitives-and-dialogs (wave 5) specifies, so that item extends it. Use it for the header CTA, Reset or Clear all, the empty-state action and pagination, replacing the three copies of the pill class string.

Dependencies:
- Land after visitor-dead-ends (wave 1; page.tsx moves to getJsonWithStatus, and the outage panel must stay distinct from the filtered-empty state).
- Land after data-states-recovery (/community loading.tsx), css-cascade-fix (globals.css layers), community-polish-1 (sort hint caption) and community-polish-2 (header retitle).
- public-pages-seo-and-cache (wave 5) caches by full URL, so the new params are cache keys automatically. The index canonical stays /community.

Tests:
- New apps/web/components/community/__tests__/CommunityFilterBar.test.tsx:
  - the input resets when initialSearch changes from 'roach' to ''
  - typing is not clobbered by a stale prop
  - pending sets aria-busy on the results
  - choosing Zerg writes ?race=Z and drops offset
  - Clear all keeps sort
  - the segmented control works with arrow keys
- Page tests:
  - the disabled Next is not a link
  - 'Page 2 of 5'
  - out-of-range offset shows 'No more results'
  - pagination preserves race, vs and skill
  - legacy ?matchup=PvZ maps to race P, vs Z
- API tests in apps/api/__tests__/communityAndGdpr.test.js:
  - race filter
  - vs=T includes vsRace 'Any'
  - the skill filter excludes null levels
  - the updated sort
  - invalid params are ignored
  - matchup still works

- the My race, vs and Skill level filters

items.title: Cleaner cards, a mobile-first build page and an accurate author profile
items.spec:
Goal: one vote style everywhere, cards that show the build rather than wasted space, primary actions reachable on phones, and author pages with accurate copy.

1) Shared VoteScore (new apps/web/components/community/VoteScore.tsx).
- Props {votes, size: 'sm'|'md'}. Renders '+3' (text-success), '−2' (U+2212, text-danger) or '0' (text-text-dim), in mono tabular-nums.
- aria-label 'Net score +3'. No ArrowUpDown icon and no ▲/▼ glyph.
- Used by CommunityBuildCard, RelatedBuilds (replacing '▲ 0' at line 82), the AuthorProfile top-build card (lines 144-145), the CommunityVotePanel score and the mobile action row.

2) Card layout (apps/web/components/community/CommunityBuildCard.tsx).
- Normal flow, no absolute chips, drop pr-24.
- Header row: matchup Badge plus a skill Badge when build.skillLevel is set.
- The title h3 is a stretched link: next/link with after:absolute after:inset-0.
- 2-line clamped description.
- New <KeySteps> strip (components/community/KeySteps.tsx) with up to 5 unit icons plus mono m:ss.
  - Sources: build.signature (sorted by beforeSec), or positive v3 rules (before / count_min / count_exact with time_lt, sorted by time_lt). Skip not_before and count_max 0.
  - Hidden when there are no steps. The list payload already carries build via PUBLIC_AGGREGATE_PROJECTION.
- Footer, as relative z-10 siblings of the stretched link:
  - AuthorChip (truncated, max-w-[50%])
  - VoteScore
  - 'Updated 3d ago' from updatedAt, falling back to publishedAt
  - the owner menu
- Remove the MessageSquare 'Open' affordance. There are no comments.
- Add a hideAuthor prop.

3) AuthorChip (components/community/AuthorChip.tsx): min-w-0 max-w-full, name span `truncate`, title and aria-label set to the full name, so an 80-character name can't overflow.

4) Owner menu (components/community/CommunityBuildOwnerControls.tsx, compact mode).

It replaces fmtDate here, which gave a server-timezone timestamp with seconds. It is deterministic across SSR and the client. appearance-and-formats (wave 6) later folds it into lib/i18n/format.
