items.title: Crash course knows your setup: live 'Your setup' checks and a real finish summary
items.spec:
Turns the self-reported crash course on /stream-studio/learn into one that checks setup.

Dependencies:
- Land in wave 4 after overlay-presence-health, whose per-surface presence (including 'dock') gives real 'source connected' and 'Dock opened' signals.
- Share one pure readiness function with that item's Settings 'Ready to go live?' checklist: new lib/streamReadiness.ts, mapping {devices, tokens, presence, multichat} to checks[]. level-up-checklist (wave 5) can reuse it.
- Replaces streamer-polish-3's interim finish copy.

A. 'Your setup' panel
- New components/stream-studio/SetupStatus.tsx is a client island that LearnPage renders above the lessons, only when Clerk isLoaded && isSignedIn.
- Signed-out visitors see exactly today's page, with no flash.
- Checks (deterministic, no AI):
  1. Desktop app paired. GET /v1/devices: seen within 10 min → 'Seen 2 min ago' (ok). Older → 'Paired · last seen 3 days ago' (warn) with a Devices link. None → 'Pair the desktop app'.
  2. Overlay source connected. Presence counts for all-in-one, widget or scene; fall back to /v1/overlay-tokens lastSeenAt ('Last seen …'). Links to /settings?tab=overlay.
  3. Chat platform configured: at least one multichat platform enabled. Links to the chat section of Overlay settings.
  4. Stream Dock opened: presence dock > 0. Otherwise 'Open your Dock', linking to the Dock URL row.
- Each row links to its fix.
- Passing checks pre-tick the matching lesson: agent → lesson 2, overlay → lesson 4, Dock → lesson 5. Pre-ticks are additive: never untick a lesson the user ticked. Auto-ticked lessons show '(checked automatically)'.
- Refresh every 30 s while the tab is visible; stop when it is hidden. This stays within presence's 1 request per 5 s limit.
- A failed fetch shows that row as "Couldn't check · Retry", never as a false 'not done'.

B. Finish summary card
- Replace CrashCourse.tsx:239's promise with a real card: the completed lessons; the three starter widgets (Session record, Opponent identity, Match result) with their enabled state from the token's enabledWidgets when signed in; and 'What to add next' links (the Practice and Community starter setups, the widget playground, Build vote).
- Signed-out users get the same card without statuses.

Tests:
- Nothing renders when signed out.
- Each check state from fixtures.
- A failed fetch shows Retry, not 'not done'.
- Pre-ticking never unticks.
- Polling stops when hidden.
- The summary card appears after all five lessons.

items.title: Settings tabs you can trust: load-error states, no Pulse ID wipe, a safe game-history wipe, a mobile tab bar that shows where you are
items.spec:
ORDER / CONFLICTS: land after the wave-1 items data-states-recovery (provides components/ui/RequestError.tsx and QueryState, and migrates SettingsFoundation's error state itself), settings-quickwins (reworks SettingsMisc and SettingsShell hash handling) and app-shell-quick-fixes (SaveBar positioning, next/dynamic tabs). snapshots-safe-restore (wave 2) later rewrites the snapshot list and restore flow in SettingsBackups.tsx. This pack does NOT build snapshot labels, Download or Delete, which that item owns. It must keep this pack's date helper, From/Until validation and dryRun count. find-anything (wave 5) regroups the sidebar and must keep the mobile behaviour added here.

A) LOAD-ERROR STATES (no editable form over a failed load)
1. New apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SettingsLoadError.tsx, a thin wrapper over RequestError modelled on BuildCheckInSettings.tsx:78-89. Title 'Couldn't load your <Tab> settings', the humanized message (by ClientApiError code), the line 'Your saved settings haven't changed.', and a 'Try again' button that calls mutate() with aria-busy while revalidating.
2. Rule for every tab: isLoading shows the existing skeleton. `error && data === undefined` shows SettingsLoadError and no inputs. A failed background revalidation while data exists keeps the form.
3. Profile (SettingsProfile.tsx:92-93,110): `serverDraft = data ? toDraft(data) : undefined`, so useDirtyForm never hydrates from DEFAULT_DRAFT. Today a failed load renders an empty editable form, and Save then PUTs pulseIds: [], wiping every saved Pulse ID. Add `hydrated` to useDirtyForm's result (components/ui/useDirtyForm.ts). The Profile save handler refuses to PUT unless hydrated is true (defence in depth).
4. Voice, Randomizer and Misc (SettingsVoice.tsx, SettingsRandomizer.tsx, SettingsMisc.tsx) render SettingsLoadError on a failed load. Today their edits never count as dirty and go nowhere without a message.
5. Foundation: check that data-states-recovery's migration uses the same component, with a retry instead of bare red text (SettingsFoundation.tsx:157-163). No duplicate work.
6. Backups (SettingsBackups.tsx:186, 207-212): when the snapshot list fails to load, show SettingsLoadError ('Couldn't load your snapshots') inside the Snapshots card instead of 'No snapshots yet'. Show the empty copy only when data has loaded with zero items. 'Take a snapshot' stays enabled.

B) SAFE GAME-HISTORY WIPE
1. New apps/web/lib/localDateRange.ts: `localDayStartIso('YYYY-MM-DD')` returns new Date(y, m-1, d).toISOString(), and `localNextDayStartIso` returns new Date(y, m-1, d+1). The API filter is date $gte since and $lt until (apps/api/src/services/gdpr.js wipeGames), so send since = local midnight of From and until = local midnight of the day after Until. The chosen Until day is then included. Today `new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')` is UTC midnight (SettingsBackups.tsx:138-145), and the Until day itself is excluded. Field labels: 'From' / 'Through (inclusive)', with the hint 'Dates use your local time'.
2. When both dates are set and From > Through, disable the delete button and show the inline error (role=alert): 'From must be on or before Through.' Server: POST /v1/me/games/wipe returns 400 bad_request 'since must be before until' when since >= until (apps/api/src/routes/me.js ~706).
3. Dry run: the same route accepts `dryRun: true` and returns {dryRun:true, counts:{games:N}} from countDocuments on the identical filter. Add gdpr.countGamesForWipe(userId,{since,until}) that shares the filter builder with wipeGames. It mutates nothing and takes no mutation fence.
4. Confirm dialog (SettingsBackups.tsx:311-336): fetch the dry run when it opens. Copy: 'This deletes 1,284 games from Oct 1 to Oct 15 (your time). Opponent records and macro data for those games go too. Custom builds, devices and overlay tokens are kept.' With no dates: 'This deletes all 12,431 games.' Confirm stays disabled while counting. Zero games shows 'No games in this range' and keeps confirm disabled. If the count fails, show 'Couldn't count the games in this range' and allow confirm.
5. Restore toast (SettingsBackups.tsx:79-81): restore is synchronous and returns counts (gdpr.js ~1215). Show 'Restored 3,402 games' from the response and delete the 'Restore queued… will swap once the job completes' copy.
6. After a wipe or restore, revalidate /v1/me, /v1/me/doctor and the analyzer SWR keys (global mutate with a key matcher) so game counts update without a reload.

C) MOBILE TAB BAR (SettingsShell.tsx:193-209, MobileTabTrigger 285-306)
1. Keep a ref to the active mobile trigger. On mount and whenever `active` changes, call scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest', block:'nearest'}): behavior 'auto' on first mount and when prefers-reduced-motion is set, 'smooth' otherwise. Guard against jsdom lacking scrollIntoView. A deep link such as ?tab=backups (used by app/legal/privacy/page.tsx:23) then shows its tab.
2. Left and right edge fades: wrap the scroller and update on scroll and through a ResizeObserver. Show a pointer-events-none gradient (from bg to transparent) only on a side where tabs are hidden.
3. Keyboard and ARIA matching the desktop Tabs.Trigger (components/ui/Tabs.tsx:148-175): roving tabIndex (active 0, others -1), ArrowLeft/ArrowRight wrap, Home/End, and activation through requestSwitch so the dirty guard still applies. Export a small helper from Tabs.tsx (e.g. useTabIds(value) → {triggerId, panelId}) so mobile triggers get id plus aria-controls pointing at the real panel id. Skip the audit's Select alternative.

TESTS: per tab (Profile, Voice, Randomizer, Misc, Backups), useApi {error, data: undefined} renders 'Try again' with no inputs, and clicking it calls mutate. Profile regression: a failed load can never PUT pulseIds: []. localDateRange under TZ=America/Los_Angeles: From Oct 1 gives 2025-10-01T07:00:00Z and Through Oct 15 gives 2025-10-16T07:00:00Z. From > Through disables delete. API: dryRun returns the count and deletes nothing, and since >= until returns 400. Mobile: ?tab=backups calls scrollIntoView on the Backups trigger; arrows move focus and activate; aria-controls matches the panel id.
items.howto: Add a 'Deleting game history' section to the help article backups-and-export (apps/web/lib/help/articles/account-data.ts, written by help-content-backfill). It says dates are your local time and both days are included, the dialog shows how many games will be deleted, to take a snapshot first, and to re-sync from the desktop app afterwards. Load errors and the mobile tab bar need no docs.

audit.title: Add a 'Couldn't load, Try again' state to every settings tab and stop Profile wiping data after a failed load
Make game-history deletion safe and give snapshots labels, delete and download
Mobile settings tab bar: scroll to the active tab, show an edge fade, support arrow keys

items.title: After pairing: Setup health on the Account tab, import controls back in Settings, and a dashboard checklist you can pair from and undo
items.spec:
ORDER / CONFLICTS: land after pairing-web-and-devices (wave 2: provides PairDeviceForm with a compact variant, the online-window and update-badge helpers) and welcome-wizard-resumable (wave 2: onboarding PUT that merges fields). A) SETUP HEALTH (Foundation tab, SettingsFoundation.tsx:166-232)
1. New apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SetupHealthCard.tsx at the top of the tab. Header: 'Everything's set up' or '2 things need attention'. Rows are pass (green check), warn (amber) or info (grey), each with one sentence and a CTA:
   - SC2 identity: pass when doctor has no `no_profile`; otherwise 'Set up profile' → /settings?tab=profile.
   - Desktop app: from /v1/me agentPaired + agentLastSeenAt (me.js:153-156), online when seen within AGENT_ONLINE_WINDOW_MS (components/dashboard/AgentUpdateNotice.tsx:14). Copy: 'Online · seen 2 min ago' / 'Paired, last seen 3 days ago: open SC2 Tools on your PC' / 'Not paired' → 'Pair a PC' (/devices).
   - Up to date: isAgentVersionAtLeast(agentVersion, release.version) (AgentUpgradeNotice.tsx:215) with useReleaseInfo. Copy: 'v0.19.0 · up to date' / 'Update available → v0.20.0' (CTA /download). If the release fetch fails, an info row: 'Couldn't check for updates'.
   - Games synced: games total and last sync time from /v1/me. Warn on doctor `no_games` with its CTA.
   - Overlay: any non-revoked overlay token with lastSeenAt is a pass ('Overlay seen 2 h ago'). Never seen is an info row 'Optional: not set up' → ?tab=overlay. Hide this row when onboarding.goals excludes streaming.
   - Replay archive: doctor `replay_archive_incomplete` is a warn with its CTA.
   - Any other doctor warning id is shown as an extra row with its own message and CTA, so future doctor ids appear without code changes.
   Each source (/v1/me, /v1/me/doctor, /v1/overlay-tokens, release info) loads on its own. A failed source turns only its rows into 'Couldn't check' with Retry.
2. Move the doctor fetch into a shared useDoctor() hook in DoctorBanner.tsx so the banner and the card share one SWR key. The banner keeps its dismiss.
3. Cloud user ID (SettingsFoundation.tsx:168, 247): show it in full in monospace, wrapping, with a Copy icon button (aria-label 'Copy user ID'; clipboard plus toast, falling back to selecting the text).
4. 'Copy diagnostics' button copies plain text: user ID, agent version and online state, browser and OS, viewport, games count, doctor warning ids, build SHA (NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_SHA) and a timestamp. Reuse help-and-feedback-menu's sanitised context builder. It never includes overlay tokens, URLs with tokens or emails.

B) IMPORT TAB FOR EVERYONE (app/settings/page.tsx:79-80, SettingsImport.tsx:204-217)
1. Show the Import tab to every signed-in user. Remove the instant.enabled gate from isTabVisible('import') and the skeleton wait for ?tab=import.
2. Section 'Desktop agent import' renders the existing, currently unused SettingsImportPanel.tsx: start (/v1/import/start), scan, pick folder, the active ImportProgressCard via useImportStatus, and the last 10 jobs from /v1/import/jobs (apps/api/src/routes/imports.js:73). Each job shows a status badge, counts, 'started 2 h ago · took 4 min', and an expandable 'Files that couldn't be imported' breakdown by reason. With no agent paired, show 'Pair the desktop app to import your replay history' with a /devices link. With the agent offline, disable Start and show 'SC2 Tools on your PC is offline. Open it to start an import.' On a load failure, show SettingsLoadError.
3. Section 'Browser import' (the current SettingsImport content) shows only while the instant flag is on.
4. Delete the orphaned SettingsFolders.tsx and SettingsBuilds.tsx (grep finds no importer) and their tests, if any.
5. Change the cancel-dialog copy in components/imports/ImportProgressCard.tsx:225 to 'You can restart the import any time from Settings → Import', linking to /settings?tab=import.

C) DASHBOARD CHECKLIST (components/onboarding/OnboardingChecklist.tsx)
1. The expanded Pair row embeds <PairDeviceForm compact/> in place of the link-away hint (180-186, 297-319). The existing 5 s /v1/me refresh (289-302) ticks the row, and onPaired shows 'Connected: HOSTNAME'.
2. The header shows '1 of 3 done' and a thin progress bar (role=progressbar, aria-valuenow/max, aria-label 'Setup progress').
3. Dismiss hides the card at once and shows a toast 'Setup checklist hidden' with Undo for 5 s. The PUT /v1/me/preferences/onboarding {dismissedAt} goes out when the toast expires, or on unmount if the user navigates away first. Undo cancels it, so no PUT is sent.
4. Misc (Preferences) tab: a 'Show the setup checklist again' button next to settings-quickwins' 'Run setup again' link. It PUTs onboarding {dismissedAt:null} merged with the other onboarding fields, then toasts 'The setup checklist is back on your dashboard' with a link to /app. The button is disabled with 'It's already showing' when not dismissed.
5. Fix the doc comment at OnboardingChecklist.tsx:45-46.

TESTS: SetupHealthCard rows from fixtures (online, offline, outdated, no games, overlay never seen, archive warning, unknown doctor id, release fetch failure). Copy diagnostics never contains a token. The Import tab is visible with the flag off and Browser import is hidden. The ImportProgressCard copy links to ?tab=import. The checklist progress count is right. Dismiss then Undo sends no PUT; Dismiss then timeout sends exactly one PUT. 'Show checklist again' keeps the other onboarding fields.
items.howto: New help articles in apps/web/lib/help/articles: 'Check your setup' (troubleshooting, slug setup-health) covers what each Setup health row means and what to do. 'Importing your replay history' (getting-started, slug importing-replay-history) covers agent import vs browser import, what 'skipped' reasons such as 'vs AI' and 'outside date range' mean, and how to restart a cancelled import from Settings → Import. Point the support paragraph of report-a-problem at 'Copy diagnostics'. Link both from the card and tab headers with HelpLink. The checklist needs no docs.

This pack only adds the toggle chevrons and the 'All releases' link. agent-installer-autostart adds signed builds and a /download expander in DownloadInteractive.tsx. DOWNLOAD
1. Error vs empty (DownloadCard.tsx:124): split `release.error` from `!release.data?.artifact`. The error state is a Card with the title 'Couldn't reach the release server', the body 'GitHub may be rate-limiting us. Try again in a minute, or download straight from GitHub.', a Retry button (release.mutate(), aria-busy) and a 'Download from GitHub Releases' link. items.title: Landing replay demo that works: real drag-and-drop, iPhone picking, recoverable errors, and one clear 'try it' path
items.spec:
Goal: the landing #replay-demo stops losing visitors. Today a dropped file navigates away, iOS can't pick a file, picking the same file again does nothing, and the error modal is a dead end. The hero should also stop offering two confusing 'try it' flows.

A. Drag-and-drop (apps/web/components/landing/ReplayDemo.tsx). Extract useDropTarget from components/instant/ReplayIntake.tsx:184 into components/instant/useDropTarget.ts, unchanged, and import it from both files. Attach its handlers to the whole demo card, not only ReplayDropPreview (539-571). Call preventDefault on dragover/drop only when event.dataTransfer.types includes 'Files', so text drags behave normally. The depth counter keeps the highlight steady when dragging over children. Highlight state: ring-2 ring-accent on the card plus an overlay 'Drop to analyze'. On drop, take the first file where isReplayFileName(name) (lib/instant/fileIntake.ts:96). If there is none, show an inline error 'That isn't a .SC2Replay file. Drop a replay from your StarCraft II Replays folder.' and make no request. If several replays were dropped, use the first and say 'Using <name>. The demo reads one replay at a time.' Ignore drops while a parse is in flight.

B. Picker. Export useReplayAccept from ReplayIntake.tsx:162 (it wraps replayInputAccept(navigator.userAgent, navigator.maxTouchPoints), fileIntake.ts:173) and use it in place of the hard-coded accept=".SC2Replay" (ReplayDemo.tsx:243). Because iOS gets a relaxed accept, validate with isReplayFileName after the pick. After reading the file, set event.currentTarget.value = '' (as ReplayIntake.tsx:317 does) so choosing the same file again fires change.

C. Parsing state: show '<file name> · <size>' (formatBytes or an equivalent helper) next to the progress.

D. DossierError (410-429) gets a footer. The primary Button 'Choose another replay' calls inputRef.current.click(). When getInstantImportMode()==='all' and the code is one of parse_failed, python_error, parser_no_output, extract_failed, parser_import_failed, preview_timeout, parser_overflow, preview_unavailable, replay_too_new or too_large, add a secondary 'Analyze it in your browser' link to /try. Wherever the message says 'Sign up' or mentions the agent, add a 'Create a free account' link to /sign-up. rate_limited keeps 'Choose another replay' with its 'wait a minute' copy. On open, move focus to the error heading (role=alert). Esc or close returns focus to the drop target. Style the links with the CtaLink or Button pill classes; ui-primitives-and-dialogs swaps them for LinkButton later.

E. One try path (apps/web/components/landing/LandingPageContent.tsx, HeroCtas 121-157). When the instant mode is 'all', remove the 'Try a replay' (#replay-demo) text link so the hero shows only Download (primary) and /try (secondary). With instant mode off, keep the current 'Try a replay' CtaLink.

F. Reposition and rename the demo. Move <ReplayDemo/> in the section order (37-55) from 9th place to directly after the Practice chapter, which pitches the build editor. Keep id='replay-demo' so old anchors still work. New kicker 'Build editor demo', headline 'Turn a replay into a custom build', subhead 'Drop one 1v1 replay and we open the build editor on your build order.' Add microcopy under the drop target: 'Drag a replay here or click to choose'.

G. Upload honesty. Next to the choose button add: 'Uploaded once to our server, parsed, then deleted.' followed by the existing PrivateTryLink ('Want it private? Analyze in your browser instead', shown only when instant mode is 'all'). Remove any wording that implies the file stays local.

Dependencies and conflicts: landing-demo-in-browser (wave 5) later moves this demo onto useInstantSession. It must keep the drop handler, accept hook, input reset and error footer from this pack, and replace line G with 'Runs in your browser. The replay never leaves your device.' landing-try-polish-2 (also wave 1) edits the hero grid and carousel in the same file but in different blocks. Land polish-2 first and rebase this pack. The shared useDropTarget extraction must keep ReplayIntake.test.tsx green.

Tests: new apps/web/components/landing/__tests__/ReplayDemo.test.tsx.
- dragEnter, dragOver and drop with a DataTransfer holding a .SC2Replay File call the upload exactly once; mock fetch.
- A dragLeave from a child does not clear the highlight.
- Dropping a .txt shows the inline error and makes no fetch.
- The input value is '' after change, and the same File chosen twice uploads twice.
- With an iPhone UA (maxTouchPoints 5), accept is not '.SC2Replay' and matches ReplayIntake's value.
- The preview_timeout error shows 'Choose another replay' and a /try link when getInstantImportMode is mocked 'all', and no /try link when it is off. rate_limited shows only 'Choose another replay'. Focus lands on the error heading.
LandingPageContent test: with instant mode 'all', the hero has no link to #replay-demo, and the demo section comes after the Practice chapter in DOM order.
items.howto: None needed beyond inline microcopy: 'Drag a replay here or click to choose' under the drop target, and the 'Uploaded once to our server, parsed, then deleted' line with the private /try alternative. Add a CHANGELOG.md 'Fixed' entry.

Clear up the two "try it" flows on the landing page (local /try vs server-upload demo)

items.title: Landing hero that holds still on phones, an accessible carousel, and current product claims
items.spec:
Goal: first-time phone visitors see the headline and CTAs first, nothing jumps every 5.5 s, the carousel meets WCAG 2.2.2, 4.1.2 and 2.5.8, and public copy stops claiming unshipped or stale things.

A. Stable height (apps/web/components/landing/HeroCarousel.tsx:124-138). Make the slide list a `grid`, with every <li> at `col-start-1 row-start-1`. Inactive slides stay opacity-0 and aria-hidden and gain `inert`; drop absolute inset-0. The tallest slide then sets the height. Keep the fade and motion-reduce:transition-none.

B. Mobile order (LandingPageContent.tsx:107). Remove `order-first` from the carousel wrapper so that below lg the H1, paragraph, HeroCtas and trust strip render before the carousel. DOM order already matches.

C. Below md, use a swipe strip instead of autoplay. With CSS classes only (no JS media query, so there is no hydration mismatch), the list is `max-md:flex max-md:overflow-x-auto max-md:snap-x max-md:snap-mandatory max-md:gap-3`, and each slide is `max-md:snap-center max-md:w-[85%] max-md:shrink-0 max-md:opacity-100`, not inert below md. The autoplay effect starts only when matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)').matches. Dots and arrows are hidden below md.

D. Real product first slide. Replace the brand-art Banner slide (Banner.tsx:61-72 as used in LandingCarousel) with a product slide using public/landing/opponent-dna.png ('Opponent DNA: every opponent's openings and timings before the game'). Add public/landing/builds.png as a further slide. Use next/image with width, height and sizes to avoid CLS, and descriptive alt text. If Banner's hero variant becomes unused, delete that variant only.

E. Accessibility on md and up.
- Add a Pause/Play toggle in the dot row (lucide Pause/Play, aria-label 'Pause slideshow' / 'Play slideshow', 44px target).

- The dots become plain buttons: aria-label 'Show slide N of M: <title>' and aria-current='true' on the active one. Remove role=tab and the dangling aria-controls (176-179).
- Pad each dot's hit area to at least 24×24 px (button `h-6 min-w-6 inline-flex items-center` wrapping the 6px bar).
- Arrows (204-208) are always visible under `[@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100`.
- Swipe on touch tablets: pointerdown/pointerup with |dx|>40 and |dx|>|dy| goes prev or next; set touch-action: pan-y.
- Left/Right keys work while focus is inside the carousel.
Keep the existing prefers-reduced-motion check (69-72). appearance-and-formats (wave 6) will later swap it for the shared useReducedMotion.

F. Copy fixes.
- StreamManagerShowcase.tsx:55 and 69-72: remove the 'Agent 0.18' chip and the 'Coming with desktop agent 0.18...' paragraph, and say 'Available now in the desktop agent.' The block also renders on /stream-studio (StreamStudioPage.tsx:318), so check both pages.

- US English: Replay Theatre to Replay Theater (LandingPageContent.tsx:334); practise to practice (94, 528); favour to favor (207); licence to license (app/legal/terms/page.tsx:69).

Conflicts: landing-try-polish-1 edits HeroCtas and section order in the same file; land this pack first. landing-try-polish-3 restyles the legal pages; the one-word terms fix here is trivial to rebase. ui-primitives-and-dialogs (wave 5) later swaps CtaLink for LinkButton.

items.title: Cookie choice you can change, legal pages that read well, and a crash screen that recovers
items.spec:
Goal: withdrawing analytics consent is as easy as giving it (GDPR), the banner works when storage is blocked, the legal pages render with real typography and navigation, and the root crash screen follows the theme and really recovers.

A. apps/web/lib/analytics/consent.ts.
- Add a module-level `let memoryConsent: ConsentState = 'unset'`. setConsent writes memoryConsent first, then tries localStorage. readConsent returns the stored value when storage works, else memoryConsent. A click now always takes effect for the session.
- Add openCookieSettings(), which dispatches 'sc2tools:open-cookie-settings'.
- Add withdrawConsent(): setConsent('denied'); set window['ga-disable-'+GA_MEASUREMENT_ID]=true; call gtag('consent','update',{analytics_storage:'denied'}) when window.gtag exists; delete the `_ga` and `_ga_<id without 'G-'>` cookies for path=/ on both the bare host and `.${hostname}` with an expired date.
- components/analytics/GoogleAnalytics.tsx calls the disable path on a granted to denied transition.
- settings-quickwins (wave 1) item 4 adds a Settings > Misc 'Analytics cookies' row. It must call withdrawConsent() and setConsent('granted') from here; whichever PR lands first adds these exports.

B. apps/web/components/CookieBanner.tsx.
- Visible when consent==='unset' or after the open-cookie-settings event (local `reopened` state).
- Reopened mode: title 'Cookie settings', a status line 'Analytics is currently on' or 'off', buttons 'Turn off analytics' (withdrawConsent) and 'Allow analytics', and a close X (Esc closes too). Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- New copy. It keeps the essential presence cookie honest: components/chrome/SitePresence.tsx sets an HttpOnly visitor cookie for the 'players online' count. Copy: 'Essential cookies keep you signed in and count each browser once in players online. With your OK, Google Analytics shows us which features get used. No ads, no data selling. Privacy Policy'.
- Buttons use size 'md' (44px) and go full-width on mobile, replacing sm/h-9.

C. apps/web/components/chrome/Footer.tsx:50-51: add a 'Cookie settings' <button>, styled like the footer links, that calls openCookieSettings(). Hide it when !isAnalyticsConfigured().

D. New components/legal/LegalLayout.tsx (client-free server component). Props: {title, updated: ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD', summary?, sections: {id,title}[], children}.
- Render a token-styled H1 (existing type tokens, not raw text-3xl) and 'Last updated October 8, 2026' via one en-US formatter. Both pages store ISO dates (fixes 'August 11, 2026' vs '2026-10-08').
- 'On this page' table of contents built from sections: a sticky lg sidebar (lg:sticky lg:top-24) and a <details> on smaller screens.
- Each h2 gets id and a hover/focus-visible '#' anchor link (aria-label 'Link to section: <title>').
- max-w-prose body spacing. Links use text-accent, underline-offset-2, hover:text-accent-hover and a focus-visible ring. Internal links use next/link (privacy:80-85 settings link).
- Remove `prose prose-invert`: tailwind.config.ts:149 has no typography plugin, and prose-invert would break light mode.
- Add an @media print block that hides header, footer, TOC and cookie banner, sets black text, and appends external URLs.

E. app/legal/privacy/page.tsx and app/legal/terms/page.tsx migrate onto LegalLayout with all 13 privacy sections keyed by id. Privacy adds a 'The short version' box at the top: 4-5 bullets condensed only from existing sections (what we collect, what we never do, analytics is opt-in, how to delete your account, how to contact us), with no new claims. The Cookies section (417-436) gets id='cookies', a <CookieSettingsButton/> client island (components/legal/CookieSettingsButton.tsx) and the sentence 'You can change your choice any time from Cookie settings here or in the site footer.'. Move ISSUES_URL (privacy:21, terms:130) into lib/siteLinks.ts. The visitor-dead-ends error.tsx augment reuses it too. contrast-tokens-and-a11y-gate (wave 5) adds app/legal/accessibility/page.tsx, and it should use LegalLayout.

F. apps/web/app/global-error.tsx. Keep inline styles, because globals.css is not guaranteed inside global-error.
- Add a <style> defining CSS variables for dark (default), under @media (prefers-color-scheme: light), and under [data-theme=light]/[data-theme=dark]. Add a tiny inline <script> that reads localStorage 'sc2tools.theme' in try/catch and sets data-theme on <html>.
- Buttons: 'Try again' (reset()) and 'Reload page' (window.location.reload()). The current 'Reload page' calls reset() (56, 70), which usually re-throws.
- Add a plain <a href='/'> 'Go to home page'.
- When error.digest exists, show 'Error reference: <digest>' with a Copy button (clipboard, select-text fallback) and 'Report this problem' linking to `${ISSUES_URL}/new` with title and body prefilled with the digest and pathname (no query string).
- Keep captureException.

Tests:
- lib/analytics/__tests__/consent.test.ts: with localStorage.setItem and getItem throwing, setConsent('denied') makes readConsent() return 'denied'. withdrawConsent removes _ga cookies from document.cookie and sets the ga-disable flag.
- components/__tests__/CookieBanner.test.tsx: hidden after Accept with storage blocked. openCookieSettings() shows 'Cookie settings' with the current state. Esc closes and returns focus. Buttons are not size sm.
- Footer test: the button renders only when analytics is configured.
- components/legal/__tests__/LegalLayout.test.tsx: the TOC lists every section id, each h2 has an id, the date is formatted, and no 'prose' class remains.
- app/__tests__/global-error.test.tsx: Reload calls window.location.reload (mocked), Try again calls reset, Copy writes the digest, and the theme script is present.
- Playwright public-pages.spec.ts: /legal/privacy at 360px has no horizontal scroll and a TOC link scrolls to #cookies.
items.howto: Add a help article 'Privacy & cookies' (slug privacy-cookies) in apps/web/lib/help/articles/account-data.ts, following the help-center-foundation convention, so it renders at /help/privacy-cookies and in Settings > Help (/settings?tab=help#privacy-cookies). It explains what the banner controls (only Google Analytics), how to change the choice (footer 'Cookie settings', the Privacy Policy Cookies section, the Settings > Misc 'Analytics cookies' row), and that blocked site data means you will be asked again each visit. If help-center-foundation has not landed yet, add the same text as a HelpSection in apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SettingsHelp.tsx. The privacy policy's Cookies section itself names the Cookie settings control. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

audit.title: Let visitors change their cookie choice, and stop the banner sticking when storage is blocked

items.title: The right next step for every visitor: form-first sign-in/up with /try context, and signed-in landing CTAs
items.spec:
Goal: returning users reach the email field without scrolling, visual order matches focus order (WCAG 1.3.2 and 2.4.3), /try visitors are told their games will be saved, the Clerk widget matches the page tokens exactly, and signed-in visitors on / get a way back to their dashboard.

A. apps/web/components/auth/AuthShell.tsx. Remove `flex-col-reverse` (line 48 and the rationale comment at 21-25). Add a `lead` prop: one value line rendered above the widget below md. Order is lead, then widget, then marketing at every breakpoint. Below md, the marketing bullets are wrapped in <details><summary>Why sign up?</summary>. At md and up they render as the normal right column in the existing two-column grid.

B. /try context.
- Add isTryResumeRedirect(value) to lib/instant/authRedirect.ts; it returns true when safeAuthRedirect(value)===TRY_RESUME_PATH, covering raw and percent-encoded forms.
- When it is true, app/sign-up/[[...rest]]/page.tsx and app/sign-in/[[...rest]]/page.tsx replace the marketing column with a new components/auth/TrySavePanel.tsx: 'Your N analyzed games will be saved to your account. Replay files stay on your device.'
- N comes from countTryGames(Date.now()) (lib/instant/localStore.ts). Pluralize correctly ('1 analyzed game'). If IndexedDB fails, say 'Your analyzed games will be saved to your account...'. If N is 0, say 'Sign in to keep analyzing. Replay files stay on your device.'.
- In this mode only, drop the overlay pitch lines (sign-in:71 'Your overlay URLs are unchanged'; sign-up:97-98 'Install the free Windows agent'). The lead line becomes 'Save your /try report'.
- auth-return-to-context (wave 5) replaces safeAuthRedirect with safeReturnPath and must keep isTryResumeRedirect and TrySavePanel working.

C. 'Latest' card on sign-in. landing-try-polish-2 deletes the hard-coded one. Once whats-new-and-status (also wave 2) has shipped lib/whatsNew.ts, render its newest audience 'all' entry as a small card (title, formatted date, link to /changelog#<id>). Without it, render nothing. Never hard-code copy here.

D. Clerk palette. Add lib/theme/tokens.ts exporting the light and dark hex values that globals.css :root and [data-theme] blocks define. lib/clerk-appearance.ts builds its variables from that map, which fixes dark colorBackground #11141b vs --bg-surface #0c1017 and light colorDanger #d6494e vs #d24449. A new test, lib/__tests__/clerkTokens.test.ts, parses apps/web/app/globals.css and asserts every mapped token matches. contrast-tokens-and-a11y-gate (wave 5) retunes those tokens and must update the map, and this test enforces that.

E. Landing (apps/web/components/landing/LandingPageContent.tsx).
- Delete LandingMasthead (62-73) and its usage.
- Wrap HeroCtas (as left by landing-try-polish-1) and the final CTA (556-573) in Clerk <SignedIn>/<SignedOut>. Signed in: primary 'Open your dashboard' to /app, plus secondary 'What's new' to /changelog when whats-new-and-status has shipped, else 'Update the desktop agent' to /download. Signed out: unchanged.
- Give the CTA row min-h-[44px] so the row does not collapse while Clerk loads.
- Under Getting started step 1 (526), add 'On a Mac or Chromebook? Analyze replays in your browser' linking to /try, only when getInstantImportMode()==='all'.
- Folding IncludedChapter into the chapters is out of scope.

Ordering: this pack lands after landing-try-polish-1 and -2 (wave 1), which edit the same hero, and with or after whats-new-and-status. public-pages-seo-and-cache (wave 5) adds noindex to the auth layouts, which does not conflict.

Tests:
- components/auth/__tests__/AuthShell.test.tsx: DOM order is lead, form, marketing, and no flex-col-reverse class.
- Sign-up page test with redirect_url=%2Ftry%3Fresume%3D1 and countTryGames mocked to 3 renders 'Your 3 analyzed games will be saved' and no 'overlay URLs' text. Mocked to reject, it shows the fallback copy. Without a redirect it shows the normal marketing.
- lib/instant/__tests__/authRedirect.test.ts: isTryResumeRedirect cases.
- The clerkTokens test.
- LandingPageContent test with Clerk mocked signed in shows 'Open your dashboard', has no masthead and no 'Download the free agent' primary; signed out shows Download.
- Playwright public-pages.spec.ts at 390×844: the /sign-in email field is inside the first viewport.

items.title: /try polish: show every opener in place, and pick the date window before the files

items.title: /try report expansion: highlights, record by map and game length, filters, and CSV and summary export
items.spec:
Goal: the /try report uses data it already computes or holds. Show highlights and map and length splits, let the visitor slice it, and let them keep it without an account. Everything runs in the browser with no server calls. It ships in wave 5 alongside try-conversion-pack, which works on the same report.

1. Highlights (apps/web/lib/instant/report.ts:135-150). The computeSeasonRecap result is already computed. Add `highlights: {longestWinStreak: number|null (null when below 2), biggestUpset, favoriteMap, nemesis, bestVictim}` to InstantReport, using lib/seasonRecap.ts:111-123 types and keeping its existing minimums. New components/instant/report/HighlightsStrip.tsx renders stat tiles under the totals line (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4):
- 'Longest win streak: 6'
- 'Biggest upset: beat <opponent> (+312 MMR) on <map>, <date>'
- 'Favorite map: <map> · 14 games · 64%'
- 'Nemesis: <name> · 0-4' or 'Best victim'
Each tile hides when its value is null, and the whole strip hides when all are null.

2. Record by map. Pure computeRecordByMap(games) returns {map, wins, losses, games, winrate}[], sorted by games desc then name. A null map is grouped as 'Unknown map' and sorted last. New components/instant/report/RecordByMapCard.tsx shows W-L plus WinrateBar, top 8, then the 'Show all N' disclosure pattern from landing-try-polish-5.

3. By game length. Pure computeRecordByLength(games) buckets durationSec into <8 min (<480 s), 8–15 (480–899) and 15+ (≥900). Null durations are excluded and noted as 'N games without a length'. A small 'By game length' card shows W-L and a bar per bucket.

4. Filters.
- New lib/instant/reportFilters.ts: filterPayloads(payloads, {matchup: 'all'|'P'|'T'|'Z' (opponent race), result: 'all'|'win'|'loss', recency: '10'|'25'|'90d'|'all'}, now). '10' and '25' keep the newest N by date. '90d' keeps games within 90 days of now; it replaces the audit's 'Re-analyze with last 90 days' idea from try-date-window-placement. Unknown opponent race appears only under All.
- New components/instant/report/ReportFilters.tsx sits under 'Your instant report'. It holds three role='group' rows of aria-pressed toggle chips. Matchup chips show only races present in the data. Targets are 44px, and the rows wrap on mobile.
- components/instant/TryPage.tsx memoizes buildInstantReport(filterPayloads(...), now) with useMemo, so every card and the game list follow.
- Status line (aria-live polite): 'Showing 8 of 23 games · Clear filters'. If nothing matches: 'No games match these filters' with Clear filters.
- Persist to sessionStorage 'sc2tools.try.reportFilters.v1' (try/catch, so a blocked store is ignored).
- In RecordByMatchupCard.tsx each row becomes a button (aria-label 'Show only vs Zerg games') that sets the matchup filter.

5. Export. New lib/instant/reportExport.ts.
- gamesToCsv(games) has columns date (ISO), map, matchup, result, opponent, opponent_race, my_mmr_pre, opp_mmr_pre, duration_sec, duration (m:ss), my_opener, opp_opener.
- Use RFC 4180 quoting. Prefix cells starting with = + - @ with ' to stop CSV formula injection. Add a UTF-8 BOM for Excel.
- Download via Blob, URL.createObjectURL and revokeObjectURL, with filename sc2tools-try-games-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. Export the currently filtered set.
- reportSummaryText(report, filters) returns plain text: 'SC2 Tools /try report: 23 games, 14-9 (61%)', W-L per matchup, top 3 openers, an active-filter note, and 'sc2tools.com/try'. It contains no opponent names, because it is meant for Discord or Reddit.
- An ExportMenu sits in the InstantReport `actions` slot next to 'Analyze more replays', with 'Download games (CSV)' and 'Copy summary'. Copy summary uses the clipboard, a 'Summary copied' toast, and a selected-textarea fallback. Use ui-primitives-and-dialogs' Popover and CopyButton if they have landed in wave 5, else two plain Buttons.

Coordination with try-conversion-pack (wave 5, same actions slot and OpenersCard):
- Its ShareReportButton 'Copy text' fallback must call reportSummaryText, so there is one summary builder.
- Its share card draws the currently filtered report with a 'Filtered: vs Z · last 25' subtitle when filters are active.
- It never draws the opponent-named highlights (biggest upset, nemesis, best victim).
- Whichever PR lands first creates the actions toolbar layout.

Tests:
- lib/instant/__tests__/report.test.ts: highlights mapped from a known recap fixture, null tiles when data is missing, computeRecordByMap order and the Unknown map bucket, computeRecordByLength at 479/480/899/900 s and with null durations.
- New reportFilters.test.ts: each filter alone and combined, newest-N ordering, the 90-day boundary, an empty result.
- New reportExport.test.ts: CSV header, quoting of commas, quotes and newlines, the formula-injection prefix, the BOM, and no opponent names in the summary.
- components/instant/__tests__/TryPage.test.tsx and InstantReport.test.tsx: selecting 'vs Z' updates the totals and game-list count, the status line reads correctly, Clear filters resets, filters restore from sessionStorage, a matchup row click applies its filter, HighlightsStrip hides null tiles.
- Playwright apps/web/tests/e2e/try-instant.spec.ts: after the fixture parse a filter chip changes the totals, and 'Download games (CSV)' fires a download event.
items.howto: Update components/instant/TryExplainer.tsx. Add to REPORT_ITEMS: 'Highlights: longest win streak, biggest upset, favorite map, nemesis' and 'Record by map and by game length'. Add FAQ entries 'Can I filter the report?' (by matchup, result, last 10/25 games or 90 days) and 'Can I keep my report without an account?' (CSV download and Copy summary; games stay on this device for 7 days). Add matching sections to the help article 'Analyze in your browser' (slug instant-analysis, created by try-conversion-pack in apps/web/lib/help/articles/). Add a CHANGELOG.md 'Added' entry.

audit.title: /try report: show the highlights it already computes, plus record by map and by game length

items.title: Context bar: one h1 per page, a back button that matches its label, breadcrumbs, and visible navigation progress
items.spec:
Problem (verified in code): AppChrome sets ownsHeading = match?.entry.group !== 'utility', so detail pages get two h1s: the bar plus ProfileView.tsx:269 or GameDetailShell's matchup-on-map h1. On /app/game the chevron reads 'Back to Replay' (surfaceTitle) but links to /app, while the in-page link goes to the opponent or reads 'Back to dashboard'. Community sub-routes have no loading.tsx. While Clerk loads, the rail and the tab bar render empty. A. One h1 (apps/web/components/chrome/AppChrome.tsx): ownsHeading = !match?.isDetail && match?.entry.group !== 'utility'. On detail pages TitleTag renders

, so /app/opponents/[id] keeps only the opponent-name h1 and /app/game/[id] keeps only the matchup h1. Section roots are unchanged: the bar stays the h1 for analyzer sections. B. Honest back control and breadcrumbs: - New apps/web/components/chrome/ChromeContext.tsx: a ChromeProvider inside AppChromeShell that holds {pathname, backHref, backLabel, trail:{label, href?}[]}. - useChromeBreadcrumb(spec|null) sets the value on mount and update, and clears it on unmount. Each value is keyed to the pathname that set it, so a crumb from the previous page is ignored during transitions. It is a no-op without a provider, because GameDetailShell also renders in the review and public fallbacks under the marketing chrome. - Default with no page override: matchSurface (apps/web/components/chrome/appNav.ts) returns backEntry, the NavEntry for backHref. The aria-label becomes `Back to ${backEntry.label}`: 'Back to Today' on /app/game, 'Back to Opponents' on the dossier, 'Back to Community' on /community/builds/[slug]. surfaceTitle stops returning the fake 'Replay' label. - Game page (apps/web/components/analyzer/game/GameDetailShell.tsx) with opponentContext: backHref = opponentProfileHref(opponentContext), backLabel 'Back to ', trail Opponents › › ' on '. - Game page without opponentContext: backHref /app, 'Back to Today', trail Today › ' on '. - Rename the in-page 'Back to dashboard' to 'Back to Today'. - Inside AppChrome (provider present), the in-page back link becomes md:hidden. Both controls now go to the same place, and desktop shows one. - Dossier (apps/web/components/analyzer/ProfileView.tsx): once data loads, set trail Opponents › , with back to /app/opponents. - The context bar renders the trail as

items.spec:

items.spec:

That item moves SyncStatus onto the shared socket, adds `inserted` to games:changed, and adds the 30 s relative-time ticker with an absolute-time tooltip; land this pack after it. agent-health-and-sync-health (W5) later adds sync-health rows to this pill's popover and must extend the popover, not replace it. pairing-web-and-devices (W2) rebuilds /devices, which the pill links to.

A. Agent pill: components/SyncStatus.tsx becomes AgentSyncPill; keep the SyncStatus export as an alias.
- Agent state comes from /v1/me agentPaired and agentLastSeenAt only. Extract a pure agentPresence(agentLastSeenAt, now) from components/analyzer/settings/AgentStatusIndicator.tsx (same FRESH_HEARTBEAT_MS of 150 s) and make useAgentStatus call it.
- Do NOT call useAgentStatus in the chrome. It mounts useLiveGame (lib/useLiveGame.ts), which opens its own long-lived streaming fetch per mount and would add a connection to every page.
- Copy by state:
  - online: '● Agent online · 12,345 games · last upload 3 min ago'
  - paired but stale: amber '● Agent offline · last seen 2 h ago' plus an 'Open Devices' link
  - never paired: '○ No desktop app linked' plus 'Link your PC' (/devices)
  - /v1/me loading: a skeleton pill
- Below sm: the dot and the game count only, with the full sentence in sr-only text.
- The pill is a disclosure button (aria-expanded, aria-controls) for a small non-modal popover. Esc and outside click close it, and focus returns to the pill.
- Popover contents: the agent line with the absolute last-seen time; total games; last upload, absolute and relative; 'Realtime updates: Connected / Connecting… / Reconnecting / Offline' as a secondary detail from the shared socket state; an 'Open Devices' link. No new API.
- Totals:
  - remove the useState copies of total and latest (SyncStatus.tsx ~L36-37) and read me.games from SWR;
  - on games:changed with inserted>0, bump the cached total optimistically and call mutate('/v1/me'), coalesced by realtime-one-connection's debounce;
  - after remounts and browser imports the count is right.
- Rename 'Polling' (~L154-161) to 'Connecting…'. If realtime-one-connection has not already done so, derive 'connected' from the namespace 'connect' event only.
- Relative times re-render every 30 s, with the absolute time in title and in the popover.

B. Strip density: in AppChrome (the SiteStats block at ~L246-256), render a new compact app variant (SiteStats variant='app', or an AppActivityStrip in components/chrome/SiteStats.tsx).
- A single row, min-h-9.
- Left: the agent pill, on every signed-in app surface, not only analyzer routes.
- Right, on xl+: a 'Community · 1.2k online' chip button that toggles the existing details panel (aria-expanded, aria-controls) holding the three site counts.
- Below xl: no site counts in the app.
- Mobile (<md): render the strip only on analyzer routes (isAnalyzerPath); hide it everywhere else.
- Signed out on /community: only the xl+ community chip.
- Persist the details expanded/collapsed preference in localStorage 'sc2tools:activity-details:v1', in try/catch, default collapsed.
- Marketing pages keep the full SiteStats unchanged.

Tests:
- New components/__tests__/AgentSyncPill.test.tsx with fake timers:
  - online, offline and unpaired copy from /v1/me fixtures;
  - relative time advances after 30 s with no new events;
  - the total follows an SWR revalidation after remount;
  - no 'Polling' text;
  - useLiveGame is never called (mock assertion);

items.title: Installed app: an Install path inside the app, and an offline page instead of the browser error
items.spec:
The manifest half of this audit item ships in app-shell-quick-fixes (W1): start_url '/app?source=pwa', id '/app', orientation 'any', #06090e colours, and shortcuts for Today, Opponents, Replays and Stream settings. It is not repeated here. A. Shared install logic: extract from apps/web/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.tsx into a new apps/web/lib/pwa/install.ts.
- isStandalone()
- detectInstallPlatform(): 'ios-safari' | 'ios-other' | 'android' | 'desktop-chromium' | 'unsupported'
- a module-level store that captures `beforeinstallprompt` (preventDefault, keep the event) and `appinstalled`.
- `beforeinstallprompt` fires once per page load, often before the More sheet mounts. Register the listener at app start from ServiceWorkerRegister, which AppShell already mounts and which already skips /overlay.
- Expose useInstallState(): {available, platform, installed, promptInstall(): Promise<'accepted'|'dismissed'|'unavailable'>}.
- The landing InstallPrompt consumes the same store; its cooldown and copy are unchanged.

B. Entry points:
- Where: an 'Install app' row in the More sheet's Help & support group, and in the Settings sidebar (apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SettingsShell.tsx, below the tab list).
- Behaviour by platform:
  - native prompt when one is available;

  - Android without a prompt: the steps 'browser menu ⋮ → Install app'.
- Hidden when standalone, after appinstalled, or on unsupported platforms (desktop Firefox or Safari with no prompt).
- On accept, toast 'SC2 Tools installed. Find it on your home screen or app list.'

C. Offline page: a static apps/web/public/offline.html, not a Next route, because the app's JS and CSS chunks are not cached.
- Self-contained: inline CSS using the token hex values for both themes via prefers-color-scheme, an inline SVG logo, and meta robots noindex.

- apps/web/public/sw.js:
  - install: caches.open('sc2tools-offline-v1').addAll(['/offline.html']), wrapped in catch so a failure never fails the install. Do not add skipWaiting; keep the existing update flow.
  - activate: delete other 'sc2tools-offline-*' caches.
  - fetch: only for GET requests with request.mode==='navigate' and a path not starting with /overlay or /dock (OBS sources should fail normally and retry), event.respondWith(fetch(request).catch(() => caches.match('/offline.html'))). Everything else stays pass-through.
  - Never cache API or page responses, and update the privacy comment at the top of the file to say so.

Tests:
- New apps/web/lib/pwa/__tests__/install.test.ts:

  - the store captures the event before any subscriber mounts;
  - appinstalled hides the rows.

items.title: Moderation queue: confirm removals, show failures, group reports and show their context
items.spec:
Most dangerous admin gap. 'Remove target' fires instantly and failures are silent. Builds only on existing primitives (PageHeader, Button, ConfirmDialog, which already has a children slot, Field, EmptyStatePanel), so it does not depend on any roadmap item. ops-console (W2) will later add audit() to the resolve route; there is no web conflict.

Web, apps/web/app/admin/moderation/page.tsx:
1) Remove confirmation. Remove opens ConfirmDialog intent='danger', titled 'Remove this {build|comment|review|opponent}?'. The body shows the target title and snippet (item.target), the consequence line for that target type (reuse the current header copy, e.g. 'Takes it down for good; the author loses 20 review karma'; for builds, 'Unpublishes the build from Community'), and a 'Resolution note (optional)' textarea (max 500 characters, with a counter). The note is sent as `note`. Nothing is sent before the admin confirms.
2) Dismiss stays one click. Each card has a collapsed 'Add note' textarea, and its value is sent as `note` with both Dismiss and Remove (Remove pre-fills the dialog's textarea from it).
3) Errors. resolve() gets a catch, so there are no unhandled rejections. A failed action shows a dismissible role=alert inside that card: 'Couldn't remove: {message} · Error ID {requestId}', with Retry re-running the same action and note. A 404 report_not_found (another admin already resolved it) counts as success: refresh, and toast 'Already resolved'.
4) Per-row busy. Replace the global `busy` with busyKey = `${targetType}:${targetId}`. Hand-rolled buttons become Button (secondary Dismiss, danger Remove) with `loading` on the clicked action only. Other cards stay usable.
5) Grouping. Group open reports client-side by targetType+targetId into one card. The header shows the target title, a type badge, '3 reports · spam ×2, abuse ×1' and the age of the oldest report. An expandable list shows each report's reason, note, reporter and time.
6) Context links. Build targets link to /community/builds/{targetId}, opponent targets to /community/opponents/{targetId}, and registered targets use target.link. These open in a new tab with sr-only '(opens in new tab)'. Each reporter links to /admin/users/{reporterUserId}. A target with no description shows 'Target no longer exists' and can still be dismissed.
7) Filter and sort. A chip row by target type (All plus the types present, each with a count and aria-pressed), and a Sort Select: Oldest first (default), Newest first, Most reported.
8) Cap banner. When the response has capped=true, show 'Showing the oldest 100 of {total} open reports. Resolve these to see the rest.'
9) Header and empty state. PageHeader (eyebrow 'Admin', title 'Moderation queue' in loading, error and loaded states, fixing the :76 vs :98 mismatch) with one line of description, 'Dismiss keeps the content; Remove takes it down.', a <details> 'How moderation works' (auto-hide at 3 reports, karma penalty, notes are recorded), and a Refresh action. The empty queue uses EmptyStatePanel: 'Queue clear', 'No open reports. Last checked {time}.', action Refresh.

API:
- services/community.js listReports() also returns total = countDocuments({resolvedAt:null}) and capped = total > 100.
- resolveReport() settles every open report on the same targetType+targetId for every target type, not only registered ones (reuse the updateMany at :1645 for builds and opponents too). That way one decision clears the whole group. It returns {resolved: n}. The route POST /v1/community/admin/reports/:id is unchanged and accepts any report id in the group.

Tests:
- New apps/web/app/admin/moderation/page.test.tsx:
  - Remove opens the dialog and makes no request until confirmed.
  - The note is posted.
  - A failure renders the alert, and Retry re-posts.
  - Only the clicked card shows loading.
  - Grouping counts and reason tallies are correct.
  - The cap banner appears.
  - The empty state appears.
- apps/api/__tests__/communityAndGdpr.test.js:
  - Resolving one report on a build target settles all of that target's open reports.
  - listReports returns total and capped.
items.howto: Fill the 'Moderation' section of docs/admin-console.md (create the file with that section if admin-polish-3 has not landed yet): Dismiss vs Remove, auto-hide at 3 reports, the karma penalty, and where notes are stored (resolutionNote, and the unpublish reason for builds). The in-page 'How moderation works' disclosure summarises it.

7) Range picker: 1d, 7d, 28d, 90d, 365d and Custom. Custom shows two date inputs and Apply, with validation from ≤ to, to ≤ today and a span of at most 365 days, and an inline error otherwise. API: GET /v1/admin/analytics/summary accepts from/to (YYYY-MM-DD). services/analytics.js summary({from,to}) builds the current range from them and the previous range as the same-length window just before. Invalid input returns 400 bad_request. The existing days path is unchanged.

12) A realtime failure (:159-160) shows a muted 'Realtime unavailable · Retry' line instead of disappearing.
13) NotConfiguredCard links to the GA4 setup section of the docs.

Tests:

- The StatusTile sr-only text is present.

items.spec:
The foundation every later admin pack builds on. items.title: Admin lists keep their place: state in the URL, debounced search, no skeleton flicker, one sortable AdminTable
items.spec:
Builds on admin-polish-3 (W1: AdminPagination, Inputs, RequestError). data-states-recovery (W1) sets SWR keepPreviousData globally. Admin pages still gate skeletons on isLoading, which is true for every new key, so this pack is still needed. admin-polish-5, -6 and -7 (same wave) land after this one.

1) New components/useAdminQueryState.ts:
- Signature: useAdminQueryState(defaults, {allowed?: enum lists, debounceMs?: per-key}) returns [state, set(patch, {history?:'replace'|'push'})].
- Reads useSearchParams and coerces each value by the default's type. Invalid or unknown enum values fall back to the default.
- Writes with router.replace(url, {scroll:false}) for filter, search and sort changes, and router.push for page and cursor changes, so browser Back steps back through pages.
- Leaves default values out of the URL, keeps unknown params (e.g. debug), and resets page/before whenever a filter, search or sort changes.
- Each page's default export wraps its body in <Suspense> because useSearchParams needs it in Next 15.

2) Pages and params:
- /admin/users: q, filter (all|with_games|no_games|with_agent), before. Fix the docstring at :27-29.
- /admin/users/[userId]/opponents: q, race, minGames, sort, order, page.
- /admin/global: q, race, sort, order, page, plus any existing filters.
- /admin/notifications: type, unread (default on; written as unread=0 when off), before.
- /admin/users/[userId]/opponents/[pulseId]: game, before.
- /admin/global/players/[pulseId]: game, owner (the game's userId, needed by the per-user game-detail endpoints), before.
- Cursor lists keep an in-memory stack for Previous. When a page loads with ?before= and no stack (refresh or a shared link), show 'First page' instead of Previous.
- ?game=: selecting a game writes it. On load, select that game even if it is not on the current page (the detail endpoints are keyed by userId+gameId) and show a note: 'This game isn't on the current page'. An unknown id shows 'Game not found' with 'Clear selection'.

3) No flicker:
- Debounce users search by 300ms (same pattern as opponents/page.tsx:71-77). The input keeps local state mirrored from the URL.
- Pass keepPreviousData:true on every admin list useApi.
- Render LoadingRows only when !data. When validating with data, the table wrapper gets aria-busy, opacity-60 and a transition, and the result count gets an 'Updating…' spinner.
- Search inputs get a clear (×) button (aria-label 'Clear search'; it also clears on Esc) that resets q and refocuses the input.

4) New components/AdminTable.tsx:
- Props: column defs {key, label, sortKey?, defaultDir?, align?, render, mobile:'title'|'field'|'hidden'}, rows, rowKey, rowHref?, sort {by, dir, onChange} bound to URL sort/order, loading (first load only), updating, empty, error, sr-only caption.
- Desktop: sticky header, SortableTh on sortable columns with aria-sort.
- One accessible whole-row link: a <Link> in the first cell with a stretched ::after overlay, and the row is position:relative. Other interactive cells sit at z-10. Remove the tr onClick (global/page.tsx:478-490) and the tr role=link/tabIndex (opponents/page.tsx:300-311). This fixes Users, where only the first cell is clickable (users/page.tsx:205-223).
- Below md, a card list renders from the same column defs.
- Clicking the active header toggles direction. Clicking a new header uses its default direction (desc for numbers and dates, asc for text).

5) Use AdminTable on users, opponents, global and the global player table.
- Remove the Sort Select and 'Highest first ↓' Order button from the filter cards (opponents/page.tsx:183-217, global/page.tsx:368-402).
- Keep only a mobile-only Sort Select, since headers are hidden on cards. Its labels depend on the column type: 'Newest first'/'Oldest first' for dates, 'Highest first'/'Lowest first' for numbers, 'A–Z'/'Z–A' for text.

6) Move raceLabel and pctLabel into components/format.ts. Move BreakdownCard (duplicated in global/page.tsx:197-254, global/players/[pulseId]/page.tsx:259-307 and opponents) into components/BreakdownList.tsx.

Tests:
- useAdminQueryState:
  - Defaults are left out of the URL.
  - Values are coerced to the default's type, and an invalid enum falls back to the default.
  - A filter change resets the page.
  - Unknown params are preserved.
  - Filter changes use replace; page changes use push.
- Users search: typing 5 characters within 300ms (fake timers) makes 1 request.
- Rows stay visible while revalidating; LoadingRows appears only on first load.
- AdminTable:
  - aria-sort is set and a header click updates sort/order.
  - Clicking any cell navigates.
  - The mobile cards render.
- ?game= selects the game on load; an unknown id shows the 'Game not found' state.

items.title: Opponent and global player games: correct tie results, head-to-head summary, filters and keyboard navigation
items.spec:
Bug: ties, 'Undecided' and null results show as Loss. Land after admin-polish-4 (same wave), and keep its ?game=/?owner=/?before= URL wiring when extracting the shared component.

1) components/AdminGameDetail.tsx:
- Replace isWin() (:77-79) with resultOf(result): 'win' | 'loss' | 'tie' | 'unknown'. victory or win → win, defeat or loss → loss, tie → tie, anything else (undecided, null) → unknown.
- New components/ResultBadge.tsx: Win (success), Loss (danger), Tie (neutral), and '—' for unknown with the text 'Result not recorded'.
- Replace every `isWin ? 'Win' : 'Loss'` site: AdminGameDetail.tsx:118-127, users/[userId]/opponents/[pulseId]/page.tsx:133-141, global/players/[pulseId]/page.tsx:371-379.
- Win rate counts decided games only: wins / (wins + losses).

2) New components/AdminGamesMasterDetail.tsx, used by both game pages:
- Takes the games list, selection, pagination, row meta render, filter slot and detail render.
- The selected list button gets aria-current='true'.
- Keyboard: j or ↓ selects the next game, k or ↑ the previous one, and Enter moves focus to the detail pane. The shortcuts are ignored while focus is in an input, textarea or select. Each selection is announced in a polite live region ('Game 3 of 25: Victory on Alcyone').
- This removes the duplicated list and pagination from both pages.

3) Summary strip on the opponent page:
- Content: W–L–T, win rate, average game length, the top maps with W–L per map, and a 'Last 10' form row of mini ResultBadges.
- API: GET /v1/admin/users/:userId/opponents/:pulseId/games returns `summary` when called without a cursor: {wins, losses, ties, unknown, avgDurationSec, maps:[{map, wins, losses, ties}] (top 5 by games), last10:[result]}. It is computed over all games against this opponent with a $group, not only the loaded page.
- Fewer than 5 decided games show a 'Small sample' hint.

4) Filters, kept in the URL with useAdminQueryState:
- Both pages: Result chips (All / Wins / Losses / Ties, with aria-pressed) and a Map Select built from summary maps or distinct maps.
- Global player page only: a User Select (userEmail).
- API: the opponent games endpoint and GET /v1/admin/global/players/:pulseId/games accept result (win|loss|tie) and map, and the global one also accepts userId. The result filter uses the same classification as resultOf.
- Changing a filter resets the cursor.

Tests:
- resultOf mapping, including null and 'Undecided'.
- ResultBadge never says Loss for a tie.
- j/k and arrow navigation, and that it is ignored inside inputs.
- aria-current on the selected game.
- API: summary excludes ties and unknown games from the win rate, and the result/map/userId filters work.

items.title: Notifications: mark single items read, unread counts per type, Open user, visible errors
items.spec:
Land after notification-center (W2), which gives admin Messages (user_message rows) a status (new|looking|fixed|wontfix) and an in-app Reply. This pack therefore does not add a mailto 'Reply by email'. It puts its actions in the same row action group as Reply and status. It also lands after admin-polish-4 (URL state for type, unread and before). The Live/Reconnecting pill comes from the realtime-one-connection augment.

API, routes/admin.js and services/adminEvents.js:
1) POST /v1/admin/events/:eventId/read and /unread set readAt to now or null. They validate the id, return 404 event_not_found, and are idempotent.
2) POST /v1/admin/events/mark-read accepts an optional {type} to mark only that type read.
3) counts() adds unreadByType {user_signup, agent_download, agent_connected, user_message}, from one aggregate $match {readAt:null} $group by type.

Web, apps/web/app/admin/notifications/page.tsx and components/AdminEventRow.tsx:
4) Each row gets a 'Mark as read' / 'Mark as unread' icon button with an aria-label. It is visible on hover and focus-within, and always visible on touch. The update is optimistic: on error it rolls back and shows a toast 'Couldn't mark as read · Retry'. Success revalidates the shared counts, so the AdminShell badge updates in the same tab.
5) When the row payload has userId (AdminEventRow.tsx:93-121), add an 'Open user' link to /admin/users/{userId}.
6) The type chips (:176-188) get aria-pressed and counts from unreadByType ('Messages 2'; the count is hidden when 0).
7) The mark-all button names its scope: 'Mark 3 messages read' when a type chip is active, otherwise 'Mark all 12 read'. markAllRead (:77-83) gets a catch, and a failure shows role=alert with Retry.
8) The 'Source: {API_BASE}/v1/admin/events' footer (:259-263) renders only with ?debug=1.
9) An empty list hides pagination and shows an EmptyStatePanel per filter, e.g. 'No unread messages', with a 'View all activity' action that sets unread=0.

Tests:
- API:
  - read/unread round trip.
  - 404 for an unknown event.
  - Typed mark-all only touches that type.
  - unreadByType counts.
- Web:
  - Optimistic mark-read and rollback.
  - Chip aria-pressed and counts.
  - The Open user link.
  - The debug footer is hidden by default.
  - Pagination is hidden when empty.
  - The mark-all error alert.

items.title: Dashboard triage: 'Needs attention' inbox, queue badges in the nav, clickable KPIs, 30-day trend
items.spec:
Lands in the wave where ops-console adds job-overdue alerts and db-offsite-backups (W1) adds stale-backup alerts as admin_events, and notification-center adds message status. Dependencies:
- After admin-polish-4: its URL state makes the deep links work.
- After admin-polish-3: grouped nav.
- After ops-console, or rebase onto it: health/page.tsx gets a Background jobs table there.
- Coordinate with the realtime-one-connection augment, which puts the Live pill in the Recent activity header.

API:
1) GET /v1/admin/attention, in services/admin.js attention(). One Promise.all of cheap counts:
- openReports: a new community.countOpenReports(), countDocuments {resolvedAt:null}.
- pendingIdentities: the playerIdentities service, status 'pending'.
- pendingChannels: the playerChannels pendingOnly total (services/playerChannels.js:258-268).
- unreadMessages: user_message events with readAt null. Once notification-center's status exists, count status in [null,'new'].
- alerts: unread admin_events of the alert type raised by ops-console and db-offsite-backups; 0 when that type does not exist yet.
- advisories: {level:'watch'|'upgrade'|null} from the cached infrastructure snapshot, never triggering a provider poll.
It returns {..., generatedAt}. Make sure indexes exist for communityReports {resolvedAt:1} and adminEvents {type:1, readAt:1} (add them through the existing index migration).

2) GET /v1/admin/events/daily?days=30 (clamped to 7..90), in adminEvents.daily(). $match createdAt ≥ start and type in [user_signup, agent_download, agent_connected], then $group by UTC day and type. Missing days are filled with zeros. Returns {days:[{date, user_signup, agent_download, agent_connected}]}.

Web:
3) Hook components/useAdminAttention.ts: one SWR key shared by AdminShell and the Dashboard, a 60s refresh, and mutate on admin:event.
- AdminShell badgeFor adds count badges: Moderation → openReports, Player identities → pendingIdentities, Player channels → pendingChannels. Notifications keeps the unread badge.
- Badges show '99+' above 99 and have an aria-label such as '3 open reports'.

4) Dashboard 'Needs attention' card at the top of app/admin/page.tsx. One row per non-zero queue (icon, count, pluralised verb, link):
- 'Read 1 user message →' /admin/notifications?type=user_message
- 'Check 2 system alerts →' /admin/notifications
- 'Resolve 4 community reports →' /admin/moderation
- 'Review 3 identity submissions →' /admin/player-identities
- 'Review 2 channel submissions →' /admin/player-channels?pendingOnly=1
- 'Infrastructure: upgrade advised →' /admin/health
When every queue is zero, show a calm 'All clear · checked 12:04' with a success icon. Loading shows a 3-row skeleton. An error shows a compact RequestError with Retry. A hint line under the card: 'How to triage' (AdminHelpLink to daily-triage).

5) Move player-identities (status) and player-channels (search, page, includeRemoved, pendingOnly) onto useAdminQueryState so the deep links pre-filter. player-identities also shows its total when the API provides one.

6) KPIs. MetricStat (AdminFragments.tsx:28-52) gets an optional href and renders as a focusable Link card with a chevron.
- Links: Total users → /admin/users; Active agents → /admin/users?filter=with_agent; Agent downloads → /admin/notifications?type=agent_download&unread=0; Unread → /admin/notifications. Fix the Unread tile copy.
- Fold the 'Downloads by OS' tile into the downloads caption ('Windows 41 · macOS 3 · Linux 1').
- Each tile shows a week-over-week delta from the daily endpoint (last 7d vs the prior 7d): '+12% vs last week', or 'new' when the prior value is 0.
- Each tile has a one-line visible caption defining the counter (signup vs install vs active agent).

7) A 'Last 30 days' chart (recharts) with Signups, Downloads and Installs per day, coloured from useChartTheme tokens (no hex). It has a legend, an sr-only summary ('Last 30 days: 45 signups, 60 downloads, 30 installs') and a 'View as table' toggle. chart-kit (W5) migrates it later.

8) Storage:
- Move the Mongo collection table (page.tsx:236-373) off the Dashboard to Infrastructure, as a collapsed 'Database storage' section below Background jobs. Its summary line reads 'Data 1.2 GB · Indexes 300 MB · 34 collections'.
- The expanded table sorts client-side via SortableTh (name, documents, data size, index size).
- The Dashboard keeps one line: 'Database 1.5 GB → Infrastructure'.

Tests:
- API:
  - attention counts on fixtures, including a missing alert type → 0.
  - daily zero-fill and per-type grouping.
- Web:
  - Attention rows, plurals and deep links.
  - The All clear and error states.
  - Nav badges and aria-labels, including 99+.
  - MetricStat href renders a link.
  - Delta maths, including a prior value of 0.
  - The chart has no hex colours.
  - The storage section is collapsed by default and sorts.

Add a 'Dashboard counters' subsection defining signup vs download vs install vs active agent. Linked from the hint under the Needs attention card.

items.title: Users: list totals, sorting, filters and CSV export; a complete user detail page
items.spec:
Lands in W3, after the W2 work on the same files:
- ops-console adds a Support snapshot (devices with version and online state, doctor output, import jobs, audit rows), an AdminActionCard and revoke-admin to users/[userId]/page.tsx.
- admin-polish-4 provides AdminTable and URL state.
- admin-polish-5 provides ResultBadge.
Build on all of these. Do not add a second Agents card.

Users list, users/page.tsx, services/admin.js listUsers and routes/admin.js:
1) Paging and totals:
- listUsers returns total (countDocuments with the same match).
- Paging switches to page/limit (50) for every sort; the old `before` is still accepted for one release. The UI shows 'x–y of N users' through AdminPagination.
2) Sorts: lastActivity (default), createdAt ('Signed up'), games, opponents, agentLastSeen, with order asc|desc, as AdminTable sortable headers.
- games and opponents sorts use a $group over games by userId (indexed), then $lookup users, then $skip/$limit.
- Record the scale note in a code comment: revisit when users exceed about 20k, or once faster-dashboards' users.gameStats exists.
3) New filters:
- signed_up_7d: createdAt ≥ now−7d.
- agent_inactive_14d: has a deviceTokens row and the newest lastSeenAt is older than 14 days, a deterministic churn signal.
- admins: role 'admin' or on the env allowlist.
4) Columns:
- Add 'Signed up' and an 'Admin' badge.
- Every relative date renders <time dateTime> with the absolute date in its title.
5) 'Export CSV' in the header actions:
- GET /v1/admin/users/export.csv?filter=&q= streams the rows matching the current filter, capped at 10,000, with a note in the UI when the cap is hit.
- Columns: userId, clerkUserId, email, signedUpAt, lastActivity, games, opponents, agentPaired, agentLastSeen, isAdmin.
- Cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with '.
- Content-Disposition is attachment, filename sc2tools-users-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.
- The web fetches it with auth into a blob download.
- Writes an audit() row 'users.export' (ops-console).
6) Drop storageEstimateBytes from AdminUserRow and from the API (services/admin.js:345-347). It is always 0 and never rendered.

User detail, users/[userId]/page.tsx and services/admin.js userDetail:
7) Tiles:
- Win rate: wins/(wins+losses); '—' with 'No decided games' when there are none.
- Last sign-in: lastSeenAt.
- First replay: games.firstActivity.
- 'Account age' is relabelled 'Signed up', with an absolute date plus the relative age.
8) Copy buttons on userId and clerkUserId: navigator.clipboard plus the existing Toast 'Copied', falling back to selecting a read-only input. Swap to CopyButton when ui-primitives-and-dialogs (W5) lands.
9) The 'Recent opponents' rows (:164-183) link to /admin/users/{userId}/opponents/{pulseId} using AdminTable's stretched-link pattern.
10) A 'Recent games' list: userDetail returns recentGames (5 rows: date, map, opponent name and pulseId, result). Each row links to the opponent drill-down with ?game=. Results use ResultBadge.
11) A 'Recent activity' card: this user's last 10 admin events. adminEvents.list accepts userId (add a {userId:1, createdAt:-1} index), rendered with compact AdminEventRow, plus 'View all' → /admin/notifications?userId=… (add userId to that page's query state).
12) Extend ops-console's Support snapshot device rows with platform and last heartbeat if they are missing, using the same deviceTokens $group the list uses.

Tests:
- API:
  - listUsers total, each sort, the three new filters on fixtures.
  - CSV escaping, cap and audit row.
  - userDetail recentGames.
  - events list userId filter.
- Web:
  - The tiles show '—' when data is missing.
  - The copy button works.
  - Opponent and game rows are links.
  - The Signed up column and Admin badge render.
  - The export button downloads.

Add one line per user-detail tile on what it measures.

items.title: Global Trends: shareable and saved cohorts, one Apply model, active-filter chips
items.spec:
Depends on two roadmap items:
- shareable-views (W3; land after it): reuse its filtersToQuery-based parse and serialise helpers and its saved-views menu component, since Global Trends already uses the analyzer FiltersContext and filtersToQuery (global-trends/page.tsx:47-48).
- global-filter-clarity (W1): ActiveFilterChips.
Also uses useAdminQueryState from admin-polish-4.

1) URL state:
- Game filters use the same keys as shareable-views.
- Population params: xr (excluded races, comma-separated), sel (all|include), pids (comma-separated, at most 50 ids; above that the URL omits them and shows 'Too many players to share by link; save it as a view'), mmin, mmax, unrated (0/1).
- URL values override defaults on mount. Applied changes call router.replace (scroll:false).
- Malformed values fall back to defaults with a dismissible notice.

2) Saved views:
- A new adminTrendViews PREF_TYPE (at most 20 entries of {name, filters, population}) through the existing prefs API.
- A Views menu offers Save current, Apply, Rename and Delete.
- Built-in presets are code constants and cannot be deleted: 'Exclude Random' (xr=R), 'Rated players only' (unrated=0), 'High MMR (5000+)' (mmin=5000).
- Duplicate names are rejected inline.

3) One Apply model:
- All controls edit a pending draft: FilterBar, the opponent race select, the detailed filters (GlobalGameFilters.tsx:55,82) and the player population (GlobalPlayerPicker.tsx:135). The filter area gets a draft FiltersContext; TrendsTab reads the applied one.
- One sticky Apply bar shows '3 changes pending · Apply · Reset'. Enter in a field applies. Apply is disabled when nothing is pending.
